This spell closes all wounds, neutralizes any poison, cures all magical contagions, and lifts any curses affecting the creature when it died. The spell replaces damaged or missing organs and limbs. If the creature was Undead, it is restored to its non-Undead form. The spell can provide a new body if the original no longer exists, in which case you must speak the creature’s name. The creature then appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 10 feet of you.

You try to create illusory terrors in others’ minds. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 10d10 Psychic damage and has the Frightened condition for the duration. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only. A Frightened target makes a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a failed save, it takes 5d10 Psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends on that target.

Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter reality itself. The basic use of this spell is to duplicate any other spell of level 8 or lower. If you use it this way, you don’t need to meet any requirements to cast that spell, including costly components. The spell simply takes effect. Alternatively, you can create one of the following effects of your choice: Object Creation. You create one object of up to 25,000 GP in value that isn’t a magic item. The object can be no more than 300 feet in any dimen sion, and it appears in an unoccupied space that you can see on the ground. Instant Health. You allow yourself and up to twenty creatures that you can see to regain all Hit Points, and you end all effects on them listed in the Greater Restoration spell. Resistance. You grant up to ten creatures that you can see Resistance to one damage type that you choose. This Resistance is permanent. Spell Immunity. You grant up to ten creatures you can see immunity to a single spell or other magi cal effect for 8 hours. Sudden Learning. You replace one of your feats with another feat for which you are eligible. You lose all the benefits of the old feat and gain the benefits of the new one. You can’t replace a feat that is a pre requisite for any of your other feats or features. Roll Redo. You undo a single recent event by forcing a reroll of any die roll made within the last round (including your last turn). Reality reshapes itself to accommodate the new result. For example, a Wish spell could undo an ally’s failed saving throw or a foe’s Critical Hit. You can force the reroll to be made with Advantage or Disadvantage, and you choose whether to use the reroll or the original roll. Reshape Reality. You may wish for something not included in any of the other effects. To do so, state your wish to the GM as precisely as possible. The GM has great latitude in ruling what occurs in such an instance; the greater the wish, the greater the likelihood that something goes wrong. This spell might simply fail, the effect you desire might be achieved only in part, or you might suffer an unforeseen consequence as a result of how you worded the wish. For example, wishing that a villain were dead might propel you forward in time to a period when that villain is no longer alive, effectively removing you from the game. Similarly, wishing for a Legendary magic item or an Artifact might instantly transport you to the presence of the item’s current owner. If your wish is granted and its effects have consequences for a whole community, region, or world, you are likely to attract powerful foes. If your wish would affect a god, the god’s divine servants might instantly in tervene to prevent it or to encourage you to craft the wish in a particular way. If your wish would undo the multiverse itself, your wish fails. The stress of casting Wish to produce any effect other than duplicating another spell weakens you. After enduring that stress, each time you cast a spell until you finish a Long Rest, you take 1d10 Necrotic damage per level of that spell. This damage can’t be reduced or prevented in any way. In addi tion, your Strength score becomes 3 for 2d4 days. For each of those days that you spend resting and doing nothing more than light activity, your remaining recovery time decreases by 2 days. Finally, there is a 33 percent chance that you are unable to cast Wish ever again if you suffer this stress.
For up to 1 minute (Concentration), every attack roll made against you takes a 1d4 penalty.

One creature within 10 feet makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed by you for 1 minute. Non-Humanoids, creatures you're fighting, and repeat targets within 24 hours auto-succeed; it ends if the target is hurt or you attack or force a save, and the target then knows it was charmed.
You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into a creature's mind. On a failed Intelligence save it takes psychic damage and subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw.

display.components: V, S, M (the stem of a thorny plant)
display.description: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns and make a melee spell attack. On a hit the target takes piercing damage and is pulled closer if it is Large or smaller.
You create a burst of thunderous sound that can be heard from afar. Each creature in a 5-foot radius must succeed on a Constitution save or take thunder damage.
You point at a creature and a bell tolls. It takes necrotic damage; more if it is already missing hit points.
You utter a divine word and each creature of your choice within 5 feet must succeed on a Constitution save or take radiant damage.

display.components: V, S, M (a shard of blue glass)
display.description: A protective magical frost covers you, granting temporary hit points. While those points remain, any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes cold damage.
Tendrils of dark energy erupt from you and batter creatures within 10 feet. Each must succeed on a Strength save or take necrotic damage and can't take reactions until its next turn.

One creature makes a Wisdom save or, for up to 1 minute, has Disadvantage attacking anyone but you and can't willingly move more than 30 feet from you. Ends if you attack or cast on another enemy, an ally damages it, or you end a turn more than 30 feet away.

display.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Ranged weapon
display.description: Bonus Action right after a Ranged weapon hit: the target and creatures within 5 feet make a Dexterity save for 1d10 Piercing, half on a success (+1d10 per slot level above 1).

You mark a creature as your quarry. Until the spell ends you deal extra damage to it with weapon attacks and have advantage on checks to track it. You can move the mark if the target drops to 0 hit points.
You unleash a blast of brilliant spellfire that ignores cover. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes radiant damage. Higher-level slots create additional blasts.

display.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
display.description: Bonus Action right after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit: an extra 2d6 Thunder, audible to 300 feet, and a creature makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet and knocked Prone (+1d6 per slot level above 1).

display.components: V, S, M (a miniature clay hand)
display.description: One creature makes a Constitution save (Constructs and Undead auto-succeed): 2d4 Force, half its Speed until your next turn, and only an action or a Bonus Action on its next turn on a failure; half damage only on a success. +2d4 per slot level above 1.

display.components: V, S, M (a twig struck by lightning)
display.description: Ranged spell attack: 2d12 Lightning on a hit. On later turns, a Bonus Action deals 1d12 Lightning automatically, even if the first attack missed. Ends if the target leaves range or gains Total Cover.

display.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
display.description: Bonus Action right after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit: an extra 1d6 Necrotic, and the target makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns (+1d6 per slot level above 1).
You tap into your life force to heal yourself. Roll one or two Hit Dice (your choice) and regain hit points equal to the total plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

display.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 25+ GP)
display.description: Summons a combat familiar (Celestial, Fey, or Fiend) in Brute, Flyer, or Stalker form that rolls its own Initiative. AC, HP, attack count, and Force damage scale with the slot level. If you already have a Find Familiar familiar, it takes the battle form and gains Temporary Hit Points instead.
Touch a willing Beast; for the duration you perceive through its senses, including any special senses, as well as your own.

display.components: V, S, M (a sliver of glass)
display.description: A 5-foot Cube of spinning daggers deals 4d4 Slashing to creatures in it, entering it, ending a turn in it, or that it moves onto (once per turn). On later turns a Magic action teleports the Cube up to 30 feet (+2d4 per slot level above 2).
You plant four pieces of nonmagical ammunition in the ground. When a creature other than you comes within 30 feet of them, one flies up and attacks it. The ammunition is destroyed after attacking.
You force a humanoid to succumb to madness. On a failed Wisdom save a twisted crown appears on its head and it is charmed by you. You can force it to attack a creature of your choice on its turn.

display.components: V, S, M (an onyx worth 50+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: An inky aura surrounds a creature you touch: it has Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and once per turn a creature within 5 feet that hits it with a melee attack takes 2d4 Necrotic. Consumes a 50 GP onyx.

display.components: V, S, M (powdered gemstones worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes, and one set of Artisan’s Tools with which you have proficiency)
display.description: Intangible spirit helpers, proficient in Arcana and with the artisan's tools used in the casting, act as one crafting assistant and halve crafting time for the duration. Consumes 100 GP of powdered gemstones.
20-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet. Each creature makes a Constitution save; on a failure it loses Concentration and has Disadvantage on Concentration saves while your spell lasts.

display.components: V, S, M (a silk flag worth 100+ GP)
display.description: Ritual. A 15-foot-radius ring holds two willing duelists for 1 hour; anyone else entering ends it. A duelist dropped to 0 HP, or hit by an instant-death effect, is Stable and teleported outside instead of dying. One extra duelist per slot level above 2.
For the duration you have Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects, and a successful save against one that deals half damage on a success means you take none.

display.components: V, S, M (a small square of silk)
display.description: You place an illusion on a creature or object so that divination spells reveal false information about its magical properties or creature type.

display.components: V, S, M (a feather, tuft of fur, and fish tail inside a gilded acorn worth 200+ GP)
display.description: You call forth a bestial spirit that takes the form of a land, air, or water beast of your choice. It obeys your commands and acts on your turn.
Up to three creatures within 120 feet make an Intelligence save. On a failure a target's Speed is halved and it can't Dash. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

display.components: V, S, M (a withered vine twisted into a loop)
display.description: 10-foot-radius Sphere within 60 feet. Creatures you choose make a Constitution save for 3d6 Necrotic (half on success), and ordinary plants wither. One creature in the area can spend a Hit Point Die to heal that roll plus your spellcasting modifier. Each slot level above 2 adds 1d6 damage and one more Hit Point Die.
For up to 1 minute a 30-foot Emanation surrounds you; when you create it and at the start of each of your turns, you can heal one creature in it for 2d6.

display.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
display.description: Bonus Action right after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit: an extra 3d8 Radiant and the target is Blinded, making a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to end it (+1d8 per slot level above 3).

A 10-foot Emanation of thunder for the duration: creatures it reaches, or that enter or end a turn in it, make a Constitution save (once per turn) for 3d6 Thunder and Deafened until your next turn, half damage only on a success. You can exempt creatures. You also resist Thunder, and ranged attacks against you have Disadvantage. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

Up to three willing creatures within 30 feet fall Unconscious for 10 minutes. A target that sleeps undisturbed for the full duration gains a Short Rest's benefits, then can't be affected again until a Long Rest. One extra target per slot level above 3.

display.components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
display.description: Spectral copies of the weapon used in the casting fly out in a 60-foot Cone: chosen creatures make a Dexterity save for 5d8 Force, half on a success (+1d8 per slot level above 3).

Intangible construct spirits fill a Medium space for the duration and move up to 30 feet when you move. On casting and as a Magic action later, they affect one target within 5 feet of them: Clockwork Force (Dexterity save, 3d6 Force, half on success) or Orderly Ward (1d6 + your spellcasting modifier Temporary Hit Points). +1d6 to both per slot level above 3.
Holy power radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Friendly creatures in the aura deal extra radiant damage with weapon attacks.
A nonmagical weapon you touch becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, and it deals extra damage of an elemental type you choose.

display.components: V, S, M (a pinch of graveyard dirt)
display.description: You touch a willing creature and put it into a cataleptic state that is indistinguishable from death. The target appears dead to all casual inspection and to spells used to determine its status.
You open a gateway to the dark between the stars, a region of cold and darkness that fills a 20-foot radius sphere. Creatures in the area take cold and acid damage and the area is heavily obscured.
One creature within 120 feet makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

display.components: V, S, M (a silver pin worth 250+ GP)
display.description: A 120-foot by 5-foot Line of silver energy: chosen creatures in it make a Strength save for 3d10 Force and Prone, half damage only on a success. +1d10 per slot level above 3. Needs a 250 GP silver pin.

display.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you can take immediately after hitting or missing a target with a ranged attack using a weapon
display.description: Bonus Action right after a ranged weapon attack hits or misses: the target takes 4d8 Lightning on a hit (half on a miss) instead of the attack's effects, and creatures within 10 feet make a Dexterity save for 2d8, half on a success (+1d8 per slot level above 3).

display.components: V, S, M (a gilded flower worth 300+ GP)
display.description: You call forth a fey spirit that takes the form of a loyal companion. It has different options for its nature (fuming, mirthful, or tricksy) that grant different abilities.

display.components: V, S, M (a gilded skull worth 300+ GP)
display.description: You call forth an undead spirit that takes the form of a ghostly or putrid undead of your choice. It obeys your verbal commands and acts on your turn.

You wreathe yourself in a spectral serpent for the duration. You gain 15 Temporary Hit Points, and the spell ends early when they are gone. You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. As a Magic action, the viper bites a creature within 50 feet: make a ranged spell attack; on a hit the target takes 1d6 Force damage and has the Poisoned condition and the Incapacitated condition until the start of your next turn. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Temporary Hit Points increase by 5 and the damage by 1d6 for each slot level above 3.

A 30-foot aura moves with you for up to 10 minutes. You and your allies in it have resistance to poison damage and advantage on saves against effects that blind, charm, deafen, frighten, paralyze, poison, or stun (the 2014 version also blocks disease).

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take in response to taking damage
display.description: Reaction when you take damage: reduce it by 4d6 + your spellcasting modifier, and if a creature within range caused it, that creature makes a Constitution save for 4d6 Force, half on a success. +1d6 to both per slot level above 4.

60-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet. For each creature in it you choose either a stretch (Intelligence save or 2d10 Psychic and Difficult Terrain until its turn ends) or a shortcut (+20 feet Speed until the end of its next turn). Repeats when a creature enters or ends its turn there, once per turn.

display.components: V, S, M (soot and a dried eel)
display.description: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of magical Darkness fog that drifts 10 feet away from you each turn until a strong wind disperses it. Creatures it touches make a Wisdom save (once per turn): 5d6 Psychic and a 1d6 penalty on saves until the end of their next turn, half damage only on a success. Can be cast as a Circle spell for a 1-mile range and permanent duration.

60-foot by 10-foot Line from you. Constitution save: 4d10 Necrotic and Poisoned on a failure. A Poisoned target takes 2d10 Poison at the start of each of its turns and repeats the save at the end of each. +1d10 initial per slot level above 4.

For the duration you shed 20 feet of bright light, resist Radiant damage, and deal an extra 2d6 Radiant on melee hits. Reaction after a creature within 60 feet damages you: it makes a Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of your next turn.

A vine sprouts within range and makes a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 feet of it: 4d8 Bludgeoning, pulled 30 feet toward it, and Grappled if Huge or smaller. A Bonus Action on later turns repeats the attack; one more grapple per slot level above 4.

A 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder of spellfire: creatures in it, entering it, or ending a turn there make a Constitution save (once per turn) for 4d10 Radiant, half on success. A creature casting a spell inside must pass a Constitution save or the spell fizzles (slot kept). You can exempt creatures. +1d10 per slot level above 4; has a Circle casting option.

display.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
display.description: Bonus Action right after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit: an extra 4d6 Psychic, and the target makes a Wisdom save or is Stunned until the end of your next turn (+1d6 per slot level above 4).

display.components: V, S, M (a pickled tentacle and an eyeball in a platinum-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP)
display.description: You call forth an aberrant spirit that takes the form of a beholder-like or tentacled creature of your choice. It obeys your commands and has unique abilities based on its form.

display.components: V, S, M (a lockbox worth 400+ GP)
display.description: You summon a construct spirit that takes a metal or stone form. It follows your verbal commands and can be customized with different defensive or offensive traits.

display.components: V, S, M (air, a pebble, ash, and water inside a gold-inlaid vial worth 400+ GP)
display.description: You call forth an elemental spirit that takes the form of an air, earth, fire, or water elemental of your choice. It obeys your commands and acts on your initiative.
For 10 minutes, a 60-foot Emanation around you: when you make an ability check to influence a creature inside it, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10.

display.components: V, S, M (a moonstone worth 50+ GP)
display.description: A 20-foot Emanation of moonlight: you and allies in it have Half Cover and resist Cold, Lightning, and Radiant. You can end the spell early for Liberation (a Reaction turns a failed save against Frightened, Grappled, or Restrained into a success) or Respite (a Magic action heals you or an ally inside 4d10 + your spellcasting modifier). Needs a 50 GP moonstone.

display.castingTime: Bonus Action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
display.description: Bonus Action right after a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit: an extra 5d10 Force, and if that leaves the target at 50 HP or fewer it makes a Charisma save or is sent to a harmless demiplane, Incapacitated, until the spell ends.

Divine energy radiates from you in a 30-foot aura. Creatures of your choice in the aura have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and resistance to damage from such effects if they succeed.

display.components: V, S, M (a Melee or Ranged weapon worth at least 1 CP)
display.description: Spectral copies of the weapon used in the casting rain on a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder: chosen creatures make a Dexterity save for 8d8 Force, half on a success.
Chosen creatures within 30 feet of you make a Constitution save: 5d6 thunder plus 5d6 radiant or necrotic (your choice) and knocked prone, or half damage only on a success.

Target within 60 feet makes a Dexterity save: 6d8 Necrotic on a failure, and on later turns a Bonus Action deals 2d8 Necrotic automatically. Half the initial damage on a success, and the spell ends. You heal half the Necrotic damage dealt. Ends if the target leaves range or gains Total Cover. +1d8 initial per slot level above 5.

display.components: V, S, M (a handful of grave dirt)
display.description: Up to four contiguous 10-foot squares within 120 feet become Difficult Terrain for enemies. Enemies there, or entering or ending a turn there, make a Strength save (once per turn): 6d6 Necrotic and -1d6 on their damage rolls until the end of their next turn. +1d6 per slot level above 5.

display.components: V, S, M (a pinch of phosphorus)
display.description: A 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder of light and thunder: creatures inside are Blinded and Deafened and can't cast Verbal spells. Creatures in it, entering it, or ending a turn there make a Constitution save (once per turn) for 2d10 Radiant plus 2d10 Thunder, half on success. +1d10 to each per slot level above 5.
Recover up to two expended spell slots of level 2 or lower. Cast at level 6 or 7, the cap rises to level 3; at level 8 or higher, to level 4.

display.components: V, M (a broken bone and a square of black silk)
display.description: One creature within 60 feet. Non-Undead make a Constitution save for 3d10 + 25 Necrotic (half on success); a Humanoid it kills rises next turn as a Zombie that obeys you for 24 hours. An Undead target instead gains 3d10 Temporary Hit Points. +1d10 per slot level above 5.

display.components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 100+ GP)
display.description: You gain Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder (your choice) and Fly 30 feet with hover. On casting and at the start of each of your turns, chosen creatures within 15 feet make a Dexterity save: 2d6 damage of a type you pick and Prone, half damage only on a success. As a Circle spell, it lasts longer and extends to more creatures.

A floating lantern sheds 60 feet of Dim Light for 10 minutes and collects a soul fragment when an enemy dies in it, up to your spellcasting modifier. Bonus Action, spend a fragment: Drain Life (Constitution save, 4d8 + mod Necrotic, half on success), Repair Undead (heal 4d8 + mod), or Ward Ally (attacks against it have Disadvantage until your next turn).

display.components: S, M (a Melee weapon worth 1+ SP)
display.description: You flourish a weapon and vanish, teleporting to strike up to five creatures you can see within range with a single fluid motion. Make a melee spell attack against each; on a hit the target takes force damage.

display.components: V, S, M (a reliquary worth 500+ GP)
display.description: You call forth a celestial spirit that takes the form of an avenger or defender. It obeys your commands and has healing or radiant abilities based on its form.

Summons a Large plant spirit (Fungus, Tree, or Vine) within 90 feet that acts right after you and obeys your commands. AC, HP, and attack count scale with slot level; the Fungus poisons at range, the Tree is armored and wrecks structures, the Vine climbs and can Dash or Disengage as a Bonus Action.

display.components: V, S, M (a Quiver worth 1+ GP)
display.description: You transmute your quiver so that it produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition. You can make two attacks with a weapon that uses ammunition as a bonus action on each of your turns.

You choose a point and cause psychic energy to explode there. Creatures in a 20-foot radius must succeed on an Intelligence save or take psychic damage and have their attack rolls, ability checks, and concentration saves penalized for a short time.

display.components: V, S, M (a piece of dried meat)
display.description: Bonus Action to start. For up to 1 minute, a Magic action sends out a 60-foot Cone; each creature in it makes a Constitution save or gains 1 Exhaustion level (it can't push anyone past level 4). All Exhaustion from the spell ends when the spell does.

A 10-foot Emanation of majesty for the duration: creatures it reaches, or that enter or end a turn in it, can be forced into a Wisdom save (once per turn) for 4d6 Psychic, Prone, and a 10-foot push, or half damage only on a success.
You create linked teleportation portals that remain open for the duration. Creatures can step through one to exit the other, and you can rotate the portals as a bonus action.

A 60-foot Emanation of deathly power; you can exempt creatures. Others can't regain HP inside it, and when it reaches them or they enter or end a turn there they make a Constitution save (once per turn): 3d10 Necrotic and Prone, or half damage and halved Speed on a success. As a Circle spell it lasts longer and a failed save also adds Exhaustion that a Long Rest won't clear.

display.components: V, S, M (an opal worth 1,000 GP+)
display.description: Six chromatic spheres orbit you. Reaction when you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage: spend one to resist that type until your next turn. Bonus Action: hurl one at a target within 120 feet (ranged spell attack, 3d6 of a type you choose). The spell ends when the last sphere is gone. One more sphere per slot level above 6.

display.components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted bowl worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: A feast for up to twelve creatures takes 1 hour to eat. For 24 hours afterward each diner resists Poison damage, is immune to the Frightened and Poisoned conditions, and has its HP maximum (and current HP) raised by 2d10. Consumes a 1,000 GP bowl.

display.components: V, S, M (polished scale worth 600+ GP)
display.description: Summons a Huge dinosaur spirit (Ankylosaur, Triceratops, or Tyrannosaur) within 90 feet that acts right after you and obeys your commands. AC, HP, and attack count scale with slot level; the Tyrannosaur bites and grapples, the Triceratops charges to knock Prone, the Ankylosaur is armored and wrecks structures.

display.components: V, S, M (a bloody vial worth 600+ GP)
display.description: Summon a fiendish spirit (Demon, Devil, or Yugoloth form) that uses the Fiendish Spirit stat block, acts right after you, and obeys your verbal commands; it Dodges if given none.

display.components: V, S, M (a gilded ladle worth 500+ GP)
display.description: A fixed cauldron appears beside you, brewing copies of one Common or Uncommon potion of your choice. You or an ally can take one as a Bonus Action, up to your spellcasting modifier in total (minimum 1); the spell ends when the last is taken. Unused potions vanish if you cast it again.

30-foot Emanation around you. You and allies inside have Advantage on Dexterity saves, take no damage on a successful save against half-damage effects, and only half on a failed one. Incapacitated creatures get no benefit.

One creature within 120 feet makes an Intelligence save: 12d10 Psychic and Disadvantage on D20 Tests on a failure. Half damage on a success, and the spell ends. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.
Divide 120 Temporary Hit Points among up to six creatures you can see within range.

One creature within 60 feet takes 6d8 Force. If it has 100 HP or fewer it is also Charmed for up to 1 minute: Speed capped at 10 feet, Disadvantage on D20 Tests except Constitution saves, and it must pass a Constitution save to cast a spell (a failed cast keeps its slot). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you fails a D20 Test
display.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet fails a D20 Test: it rerolls with Advantage and must use the new roll. On a success it gains 6d10 Temporary Hit Points.

Imbue a creature you touch for the duration: whenever it casts a spell with a slot, it can spend Hit Point Dice equal to the slot level and regain HP equal to the roll plus your spellcasting modifier.

One creature within 60 feet makes a Charisma save or is Charmed and Incapacitated, walking straight toward you and taking 4d8 Psychic if it ends a turn within 5 feet of you. It rerolls before entering harmful terrain. Each later turn, a Magic action targets a new creature. +1d8 per slot level above 7.

Up to three creatures within 90 feet make an Intelligence save: 7d6 Psychic and Stunned with halved Speed on a failure, half damage on a success. A Stunned target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

A glowing mote hovers over you, giving you Three-Quarters Cover. On casting and as a Bonus Action later, it fires a bolt at a creature within 120 feet (ranged spell attack, 4d10 + your spellcasting modifier Force or Radiant). When you succeed on a save against a single-target spell of level 7 or lower, a Reaction turns it back on its caster.

A tangible Huge shadow dragon appears within 120 feet, immune to damage and conditions. Enemies who see it make a Wisdom save or drop what they hold and are Frightened. Bonus Action: move it 60 feet and breathe a 60-foot Cone, Intelligence save for 6d6 of a damage type you chose (half on success). A Study action and Investigation check can reveal it.

display.components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a glass ring)
display.description: Bonus Action. A 10-foot Emanation crackles around you; creatures it reaches, or that enter or end a turn in it, can be forced into a Constitution save for 3d6 Lightning plus 3d6 Thunder and Deafened for 1 minute (half damage only on a success). Magic action: a 60-foot Line, Dexterity save for 6d6 Lightning (half on success).

display.castingTime: Reaction, which you take when you fail a D20 Test or when a creature hits you with an attack roll
display.description: Reaction when you fail a D20 Test or are hit by an attack: your roll becomes a 20, or the attacker's roll becomes a 1.

display.components: V, S, M (a pair of linked silver rings)
display.description: You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature. You can communicate telepathically across any distance as long as you are on the same plane, and the link lasts until you dismiss it or one of you dies.

A 3-foot planar rift makes two melee spell attacks on casting (10d6 Force each, Critical Hit on 18 or higher) and, as a Bonus Action on later turns, moves 60 feet and attacks twice again. It passes through any barrier, including Wall of Force.

display.components: V, S, M (a piece of tinder)
display.description: Target within 500 feet makes a Constitution save, taking 10d10 Fire (half on success). Then everything else in a 60-foot Emanation around it makes a Dexterity save for 10d10 Fire (half on success), with Disadvantage if the first target dropped to 0 HP. Unattended flammable objects ignite.

display.components: V, S, M (a tiny hourglass worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: 10-minute cast; consumes a 500 GP hourglass. Watch past events within 500 feet over the last 10 years at about a day per second, pausing, rewinding, or skipping as you like.

display.components: V, S, M (a piece of adamantine worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: You have Immunity to all damage for up to 10 minutes. Consumes a 500 GP piece of adamantine.

display.components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth 250+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: A willing creature you touch becomes living metal for up to 1 hour: its Exhaustion can't increase, it resists Bludgeoning, Fire, Piercing, and Slashing, and it is immune to Poison damage and the Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned conditions, ending any of those it has. Consumes 250 GP of diamond dust.

One creature within 120 feet makes an Intelligence save or takes 10d12 Psychic and is Paralyzed for up to 1 minute. Each failed repeat save at the end of its turns adds an Exhaustion level; a success ends it. Someone within 5 feet can use an action to shake it free.

Up to ten creatures within 60 feet that can hear you. Any with 50 HP or fewer die. The rest make a Constitution save: 12d10 Psychic and Deafened for 1 hour on a failure, half damage only on a success.

A willing creature you touch can, until the spell ends, take a Magic action to exhale a 15-foot Cone of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison (chosen at casting): Dexterity save for 3d6, half on a success. +1d6 per slot level above 2.

display.components: V, S, M (a gem worth 100+ GP)
display.description: Summon a Tiny homunculus (Homunculus Servant stat block) that replaces any earlier one. It acts right after you, obeys you, Dodges if given no orders, and can deliver your touch spells within 120 feet as a Reaction. A higher slot raises its Hit Points and Force Strike.

display.components: V, S, M (a playing card depicting a rogue)
display.description: One creature in range makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 4d4 psychic damage and must at once use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature you choose and can see; if it can't, it instead has disadvantage on its next attack roll before your next turn starts. On a success it takes half damage only. +1d4 per slot level above 3rd.

display.components: V, S, M (a gilded playing card worth 400+ gp depicting an avatar of death)
display.description: A reaper spirit appears in an unoccupied space you can see in range, using the reaper spirit stat block, until it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends. It is your ally, acts right after you on your initiative, and follows your verbal commands (no action); without commands it Dodges and avoids danger. Cast with a higher slot, use that level wherever the stat block refers to the spell's level.

display.components: V, S, M (a deck of cards)
display.description: Each creature in a 15-foot cone makes a Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 2d10 force damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn; on a success it takes half damage only. +1d10 per slot level above 2nd.

A set of Artisan's Tools of your choice appears, and you are proficient with them. They vanish when the spell ends (anything made with them stays), and the spell ends early if you recast it or move more than 10 feet from them. With a level 3 slot, you craft nonmagical items as fast as two characters.

You look fully focused and attentive for the duration, whatever you are really doing, even napping. A creature that uses a Search action to read your state of mind sees through it with a Wisdom (Insight) check against your spell save DC.

You touch a creature and make a promise of up to 25 words. If you knowingly break it during the spell, the target learns of it if within 1 mile, and you catch fire, taking 1 Fire damage at the start of each of your turns.

display.components: V, S, M (a set of clothing)
display.description: You restyle a set of nonmagical clothing no one else is wearing: color, cut, decoration and form, worth up to 15 GP (rags to fine clothes, or the reverse). It reverts when the spell ends.

display.components: S, M (metallic flakes and a pinch of phosphorus)
display.description: Ranged spell attack against one creature: 3d4 Radiant on a hit. Hit or miss, the orb bursts; the target and each creature within 10 feet of it make a Constitution save or have the Blinded condition until the end of their next turn. +1d4 per slot level above 2.
A willing creature you touch grows a hard shell and gains +3 AC. If it moves or uses its action, Bonus Action, or Reaction, the bonus drops to +1 until the start of its next turn.

display.components: V, S, M (a fragment of a meteorite)
display.description: Ranged spell attack against one creature you can see: 6d12 Necrotic on a hit. Hit or miss, it takes 3d12 Necrotic at the end of its next turn and you regain that many Hit Points. Both amounts +1d12 per slot level above 7.

display.components: V, S, M (a mixture of water and powdered silver)
display.description: Pick Cold or Radiant. Each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save: 4d10 of that type on a failure (half on a success). A failed save against Cold also gives Disadvantage on its next D20 Test before the end of your next turn; against Radiant, the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn. +1d10 per slot level above 3.

display.components: V, S, M (a dab of honey)
display.description: A loud spectral bee hovers around a creature you can see. It has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and Concentration saves, and gains no benefit from the Invisible condition. The bee ends if the target goes more than 120 feet from you.

A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on Intelligence checks and Concentration saves as a tune loops in its head. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. One extra target per slot level above 1.

You make a provocative statement. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere within range makes an Intelligence save or is Charmed for the duration (no shared language or Intelligence under 3 means automatic success). A Charmed target spends its turns arguing the point, has Speed 0, and is Blinded and Deafened to everyone but you and other targets. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

display.components: V, S, M (a small piece of bark and several snake scales)
display.description: Up to four nonmagical sticks (quarterstaff size or smaller wood such as torches or spears) you can see become Venomous Snakes; a creature holding one can make a Charisma save to stop it. The snakes are Friendly to you, act right after you, and obey your Bonus Action commands within 500 feet, otherwise Dodging. At 0 HP a snake reverts, extra damage carrying to the object. Two more objects per slot level above 4.

display.components: V, S, M (a cup of sap)
display.description: A creature you can see makes a Constitution save. Failure: it is Restrained as its flesh turns to bark; success: Speed 0 until the start of your next turn. While Restrained it saves at the end of each turn: three successes end it, three failures turn it into a tree (Petrified). Destroying the tree kills it. Greater Restoration or Wish reverses it within a year; after a year and a day it is permanent.

display.components: S, M (a statuette of a hedgehog)
display.description: Gain 2d10 Temporary Hit Points. A creature that hits you with a melee attack takes Force damage equal to the temp HP the hit removed. The spell ends when the temp HP are gone. +2d10 temp HP per slot level above 1.
Up to three creatures gain +1 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons, and those weapons' normal and long ranges double. One extra creature per slot level above 1.

display.components: V, S, M (a book of religious or legal importance)
display.description: A willing creature makes a promise, oath, or contract. If it breaks it during the spell you know at once and thereafter know its distance and direction; you also know if the spell is dispelled. Duration becomes 30 days with a level 3-4 slot, 1 year with level 5-6, and until dispelled with level 7+.

A creature makes a Constitution save: 3d10 Necrotic, half on success. If the damage equals or exceeds its Constitution score, it floats 5 feet up until the start of your next turn, moving only by pulling along surfaces, then drifts down.

Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die as part of casting or it fails. A weapon you touch weeps red near Undead within 30 feet, and once per turn your hit with it on an Undead adds Radiant damage equal to a roll of the spent Hit Dice. One extra Hit Die per slot level above 1; Concentration lasts up to 10 minutes at level 2 and 1 hour at level 3+.

A nonmagical weapon you touch festers the first creature it hits: Constitution save or it takes 2d6 Necrotic at the start of each of its turns for the duration (one wound at a time). Any healing ends it. +1d6 per slot level above 2.

display.components: V, S, M (a rag soaked in your own blood)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend three Hit Dice or it fails; the touched creature gains temp HP equal to their roll. For the duration you know its direction and distance, talk telepathically, and can target it with your Self or Touch spells at any range on the same plane. If it ends the spell early it loses the temp HP and takes that much Necrotic. Duration 8 hours with a level 5-6 slot, 24 hours at 7-8, 7 days at 9.
Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. Roll it twice and regain the total plus your spellcasting modifier. One extra Hit Die per slot level above 1.

Sangromancy. Spend six Hit Dice or it fails. A 100-foot by 10-foot Line of blood: Dexterity save or pushed 100 feet along it, Prone, and Bludgeoning equal to the Hit Dice roll + spellcasting modifier; half damage only on success. One extra Hit Die per slot level above 6.

display.components: V, S, M (a ruby worth 10 GP)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend two Hit Dice or it fails. A red wisp circles you with HP equal to their roll + your spellcasting modifier, AC 10 + that modifier, and your saves. When you roll spell damage you can reroll one die; the wisp takes damage equal to the new roll, and the spell ends at 0 HP. One extra Hit Die per slot level above 2.
Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. A willing creature takes Fire damage equal to the Hit Die's roll and stops being Poisoned.

Sangromancy. Spend seven Hit Dice or it fails. Teleport inside a creature you can see and burst out to the nearest open space. It makes a Constitution save, taking Necrotic equal to the Hit Dice roll + spellcasting modifier, half on success. One extra Hit Die per slot level above 7.

display.components: S, M (a stamp carved like the mark left by your calling card)
display.description: Leave a visible or Invisible magical mark on a corpse you touch. Anyone who uses a Study action to examine the corpse finds it.

display.components: V, S, M (a fang from a rabid animal)
display.description: A touched creature becomes a rabid beast and gains 20 temp HP. It has AC 17 if lower, +5 to Strength-based damage, a Bonus Action Bite (1d6 + Str mod Slashing), immunity to Frightened, and can't cast spells or concentrate. At the start of each turn it makes a DC 10 Wisdom save or loses control for the rest of the spell, attacking the nearest creature each turn.

Hooked chains fill a 20-foot-radius Sphere within range. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save: 8d6 Piercing and Restrained while there on a failure. A creature entering or starting its turn there saves or is Restrained. A Restrained creature can use an action for an Athletics check against your DC to escape, and takes 3d6 Bludgeoning at the end of each of its turns. +1d6 to both per slot level above 6.

display.components: V, S, M (a piece of parchment with a circle drawn in humanoid blood)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend four Hit Dice or it fails. A 20-foot-radius, 100-foot-high Cylinder of blood erupts; each creature in it makes a Constitution save, taking Necrotic equal to the Hit Dice roll + spellcasting modifier, half on success. Gain 10 temp HP for each creature that fails.

A Large mass of animated plants appears within range. You are Lightly Obscured within 5 feet of it, others can't enter its space, and it moves up to 30 feet when you move. When it comes within 5 feet of a creature, or a creature enters or ends its turn within 5 feet of it, you can force a Dexterity save (once per turn) for 3d6 Slashing. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

display.components: V, S, M (a 1-ounce fresh or magically preserved portion of another creature's brain)
display.description: Eat part of a dead, non-Undead creature's brain (dead under 3 days unless preserved). For the hour, as a Magic action make a spellcasting ability check against its Intelligence score to recall one memory; you get one try per piece of information.

Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. A creature within range takes Necrotic equal to the Hit Die roll, and takes it again at the end of each of its turns until it succeeds on a Constitution save. One extra target per slot level above 1.

Sangromancy. Spend eight Hit Dice or it fails. Their roll sets the target's Creeping Death threshold: if its HP drop to that number or lower, it dies. As a Bonus Action force a Constitution save; add 2d6 to the threshold on a failure or half on a success. Three successful saves end the spell.

Your hand detaches and becomes a Spider you can talk to telepathically within 100 feet; as a Magic action you see and hear through it until your next turn, unaware of your own surroundings. Call it back with a Bonus Action. If it dies or doesn't return before the spell ends, your hand regrows and you take 1d6 Psychic.

Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. A blood whip forms: a proficient Simple weapon with Light, Finesse, and Reach that uses your spellcasting modifier, deals Necrotic with a die equal to the Hit Die spent, and reduces the target's HP maximum by the damage dealt. With a level 3-4 slot you attack twice with it per Attack action; level 5+ three times.
A crown of holy fire sheds Bright Light 30 feet and Dim Light 30 more. Any Fiend, Fey, or Undead that moves within 30 feet of you or starts its turn there takes 2d8 Radiant.

display.components: V, S, M (a dagger encrusted in jewels worth 100+ GP)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend four Hit Dice or it fails. Make a melee spell attack with the dagger: on a hit, Necrotic equal to the Hit Dice roll + 4d8. If it kills the target, gain a dark blessing for 10 minutes (or until you drop to 0 HP): Unassailable (Advantage on all saves), Unbreakable (grow one size, temp HP equal to Con mod each turn, +1d4 weapon damage), or Unerring (+2 Proficiency Bonus). While blessed, Radiant damage hurts you for an extra 1d4. +1d8 per slot level above 4.
A creature makes a Constitution save: 2d6 Force and Stunned until the end of its next turn on a failure, damage only on success. One extra target per slot level above 2.

An earthen maw rises within range. As a Bonus Action make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it: 3d8 + spellcasting modifier Piercing, and a Large or smaller target makes a Dexterity save or is swallowed (Blinded, Restrained, Total Cover, 6d6 Bludgeoning at the start of each of your turns). A swallowed creature escapes with an action and an Athletics check against your DC, landing Prone within 10 feet. Move the worm 30 feet as a Bonus Action.

Pick an element; each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d6 of its type (half and no extra effect on success). Air (Thunder): pushed 10 feet. Coldfire (Cold): Frightened until the start of your next turn. Earth (Bludgeoning): Speed 0 until the end of its next turn. Fire: burns for 2d6 Fire at the end of its next turn unless put out (an action dropping Prone, or dousing). Water (Acid): Prone. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

display.components: V, S, M (a diamond vial holding at least an ounce of blood, worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: A nonmagical weapon becomes a magic weapon that requires Attunement (you attune on casting), with a benefit set by the blood used. Aberration: +1d6 Psychic and telepathy with anything it hurt in the last 24 hours. Celestial: +1d6 Radiant and Bonus Action light (30 feet bright, 30 dim). Dragon: crit on 19-20 and Advantage on saves against Frightened. Fey: +1d4 Force and, once per turn on a hit within 30 feet, teleport next to the target. Fiend: +1d6 Necrotic, switchable to Cold or Fire as a Bonus Action. Lasts while you stay attuned (Dispel Magic can end it) and becomes permanent after a year.

display.components: M (a vial of oil and water)
display.description: An energy copy of a Simple or Martial weapon appears in your hand. You are proficient with it, use your spellcasting modifier for attack and damage, deal Force damage, need no ammunition, and it returns after being thrown. +1d4 damage per slot level above 2; 8-hour duration with a level 5+ slot.

Sangromancy. Spend three Hit Dice or it fails. Pull pounds of iron equal to their roll from your blood and shape it into crude but working nonmagical metal objects of that total weight. One more Hit Die per slot level above 3.

display.components: V, S, M (a handful of sulfur)
display.description: A willing creature you touch grows red scales: Resistance to Cold, Fire, and Lightning, and Immunity to Poison damage.

A creature makes a Constitution save; on a failure it takes 4d6 Fire, on a success the spell ends. While it lasts the target takes 2d6 Fire at the start of each turn and repeats the save each turn: three successes end it, three failures deal 8d6 Fire and end it. Initial damage +1d6 per slot level above 3.

Ranged spell attack: 8d6 Necrotic on a hit. On each later turn, as a Magic action force the same creature to make a Constitution save for 8d6 Necrotic (half on success), even if the first attack missed. Ends if it leaves range, drops to 0 HP, or you can't see it.

A creature makes a Constitution save: 8d10 Necrotic, and its flayed skin rises as your Fleshling Construct (AC 11 + spell level, HP 70 + 10 per level above 7; Strangle grapples, silences, and suffocates for 2d8 + spell level Bludgeoning; Constrict repeats that damage). Half damage and no construct on success. It acts after you, obeys spoken commands, and vanishes at 0 HP or when the spell ends.
A creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened until the start of your next turn.
An object up to 10 feet across sheds silvery Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light 20 more, visible only to creatures you chose within 10 feet when casting.

display.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, a pinch of bone dust, and a black onyx worth 75+ GP per CR animated)
display.description: Raise up to five Undead of CR 2 or lower from corpses in range. Command any or all within 120 feet with a Bonus Action; uncommanded they only defend themselves. Control lasts 24 hours; recasting on up to four of them renews it without costly components. One more creature per slot level above 5.

display.components: V, S, M (a ruby worth 100+ GP)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend six Hit Dice or it fails. Ranged spell attack with a blood arrow: Piercing equal to the Hit Dice roll on a hit. While it burrows, the first hit against the target after each of its turns is a crit. It makes a Constitution save at the end of each turn; on a success it takes 3d8 Necrotic and the spell ends.

Ranged spell attack: 1d8 Radiant. A Fey, Fiend, or Undead hit also loses 10 feet of Speed and can't take Reactions until the end of its next turn. Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, and 4d8 at 17.
A willing creature you touch treats d20 rolls of 9 or lower on Wisdom (Perception) checks as 10.

An illusory copy of a mundane instrument, tangible only to you, that works as a Spellcasting Focus and ends if you move 10 feet from it. As a Bonus Action it can mimic everyday sounds, keep a beat, or record and loop what it plays or hears within 15 feet.

Any number of creatures in range that can see you make a Wisdom save (with Advantage if your side is fighting them) or are Charmed and Friendly to you until the spell ends or your side damages them. Charmed creatures must attack or move toward the nearest creature other than you and your allies, repeating the save each turn.

display.components: V, S, M (a quill or a vial of ink)
display.description: While the spell lasts, each Magic action copies one page of nonmagical text or image you touch onto a medium you supply. Copying a spellbook this way takes half the usual time and gold.

Immunity to Poison damage and Poisoned; you can tell whether creatures within 30 feet resist or are immune to poison. Bonus Action: a creature within 30 feet makes a Constitution save or loses its Poison Resistance or Immunity until your next turn ends. Magic action: a 15-foot by 5-foot Line of venom, Constitution save for 4d6 Poison and Poisoned until your next turn ends, half on success.
A 15-foot Emanation: other creatures that enter or start their turn in it take 4d6 Necrotic. At the start of your turn you regain 4d6 HP plus 1 per creature in it.

A creature makes a Wisdom save or is tethered to you: whenever you take damage it takes half as much (round down) as Necrotic. If it drops to 0 HP, a Bonus Action moves the tether to a new creature (Wisdom save). Two tethers with a level 4 slot, three at 6, four at 8.

display.components: S, M (an item of personal sentimental value worth 1+ SP)
display.description: You die and next turn rise as a Ghost (keeping your HP, Hit Dice, mental scores, and languages, adding PB to its attacks and DCs). After a secret 1d8 hours, at 0 HP as a Ghost, or when you end it, you return to life at half HP if the keepsake is still on your corpse, otherwise you die. If your body is destroyed meanwhile you stay a Ghost until raised.

A short lecture gives up to 10 willing creatures one spell you know or have prepared (prepared for free), one skill you are proficient in, or one language you know, for the duration. A new casting on a creature ends the old one. Duration 3 days with level 3-4 slots, 10 days at 5-6, 30 days at 7-8, 1 year at 9.

display.castingTime: Reaction, when you are targeted by a spell
display.components: V, S, M (a polished silver marble)
display.description: Redirect a spell targeting you to a creature of your choice within 60 feet. Level 5 or lower spells redirect automatically; higher ones need a spellcasting check against DC 10 + the spell's level.

display.components: V, S, M (a vial of quicksilver)
display.description: A creature and a metal object it holds or wears: Dexterity save (Advantage if the item is magical) or 5d8 Fire and the item melts to the ground. Touching it during the spell melts it again and deals 5d8 Fire. +1d8 per slot level above 6.

display.castingTime: Reaction, when you see a creature within 60 feet casting a spell
display.description: Copy and cast a spell of level 3 or lower being cast within 60 feet (not your own): automatic for level 2 or lower, otherwise a spellcasting check against DC 10 + its level. You use no slot or components and cast it at its lowest level with your own modifier and DC. A higher slot raises the maximum level you can copy.

display.components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted humanoid skull worth 200+ GP)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend five Hit Dice or it fails. An Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend in range makes a Charisma save or loses current and maximum HP equal to the roll; for the duration it loses all damage Resistances and Immunities, becomes a Humanoid, and takes +1d4 Necrotic whenever it is damaged. If it drops to 0 HP it dies and the change is permanent unless revived and then cured with Remove Curse.

display.components: V, S, M (a sprig of sage)
display.description: A willing creature you touch can't be perceived by Fey, Fiends, Celestials, or Undead. It ends when the target attacks, deals damage, casts a spell, or comes within 5 feet of one. One extra target per slot level above 1.

Vines grip a Huge or smaller creature or loose object. A creature makes a Strength save or is Restrained (repeat each turn). An object can't be moved (Athletics against your DC to free it) and is easy to climb. One extra target per slot level above 2.

A creature you can see ends Poisoned, has curses suppressed, heals to full, and has any ability score under 18 raised to 18 for 1 minute, plus a blessing. Aphaelon: immune to Charmed and Reaction to reroll a failed save. Empyreus: immune to Frightened and +4d6 Force on its first hit each turn. Miklas: immune to Poison and regains 4d6 HP each turn. Morael: 30 temp HP and Reaction to take damage for an ally within 60 feet. Solyma: immune to Thunder and Reaction to return Fire damage equal to damage taken. Zabriel: Truesight 60 feet and grants Heroic Inspiration to an ally each turn.

You die in holy fire: each creature in a 30-foot Emanation makes a Constitution save, taking 30d6 Radiant and 1 Exhaustion level, half damage only on success. Creatures it kills are incinerated and need True Resurrection or Wish. Ten minutes later you rise as if by True Resurrection.

A creature with 125 HP or fewer takes 8d10 Necrotic and is Prone; a healthier one has Speed 0 until the start of your next turn. It makes a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition.

display.components: V, S, M (a sack containing a pinch of salt)
display.description: Up to 5 pounds of food or other perishables in a sack don't age or rot for 12 hours.

display.components: V, S, M (a handful of clay)
display.description: A creature you touch speaks Primordial and gains an element's gift. Air: Resistance to Lightning and Thunder, fly 30 feet. Coldfire: Resistance to Cold, and a Bonus Action to spend and roll a Hit Die to heal it + Con mod (not on the turn after taking Fire damage). Earth: Advantage on saves against being moved or knocked Prone, Tremorsense 30 feet. Fire: Resistance to Fire, and a Reaction melee attack against an adjacent creature that damages it. Water: Resistance to Acid, water breathing, swim 60 feet.

display.components: V, S, M (wilted daisies and herbal powders worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend three Hit Dice or it fails. A creature dead under 10 minutes (not of old age) returns at 1 HP plus temp HP equal to their roll, losing 1 of those temp HP each turn. While it has them it gets +2 to D20 Tests; when they run out it gains 1 Exhaustion level. Missing parts aren't restored.

display.components: V, S, M (a sponge soaked in blood)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend eight Hit Dice or it fails. Within 1d6 x 5 minutes blood rains within 5 miles. Beasts and Plants there make a Wisdom save or are Frightened until a minute outside it; ordinary plants wither. Every 10 minutes in the rain a creature gains 1 Exhaustion and takes 2d10 Necrotic that also lowers its HP maximum until that Exhaustion is gone, and it auto-fails saves to end Poisoned meanwhile. Afterward wildlife shuns the area for days equal to the Hit Dice roll.

display.components: V, S, M (a length of copper wire)
display.description: You become lightning and travel to a space within 60 feet; each creature in the 5-foot-wide Line makes a Dexterity save, 4d6 Lightning or half. +1d6 and +10 feet of length per slot level above 4.

display.components: V, S, M (a needle dipped in your blood)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend seven Hit Dice or it fails. A creature you can see takes Piercing equal to their roll, and seven blood darts burst from it toward creatures within 60 feet of it (any mix, including the target). Each dart is a ranged spell attack dealing one Hit Die roll of Piercing. One more Hit Die and dart per slot level above 7.

display.components: V, S, M (an object shaped like a creature worth 1+ CP)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend three Hit Dice or it fails. A figurine becomes your poppet (AC 10 + PB + spellcasting mod, 30 HP), ending if destroyed or over a mile away. Bonus Action: move it 30 feet and see and hear through it until your next turn. Magic action: detonate it; each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere makes a Dexterity save for Necrotic equal to the Hit Dice roll, half on success. One more Hit Die and 1 more hour per slot level above 3.

Sangromancy. Spend two Hit Dice or it fails. Gain 5 temp HP for each creature within 30 feet (you included) below its HP maximum, up to 15, and Half Cover while you have them; they vanish when the spell ends. Cap +5 per two slot levels above 2.

display.components: V, S, M (wax mixed with lead and a stamp)
display.description: Mark a creature you can see. The next time it casts a spell it makes a Charisma save: on a failure the slot is spent for no effect, on a success it casts normally but takes 3d8 Force. The spell then ends. +1d8 per slot level above 2.

Sangromancy. Spend two Hit Dice or it fails (creatures immune to Exhaustion are immune). You see whether creatures are blood relatives and whether they are at full, below full, at half, or under half HP. Once per turn when you hit a Bloodied creature, add Necrotic equal to a roll of the spent Hit Dice. Concentration up to 1 hour with a level 3-4 slot, 8 hours at 5+.
Your tongue becomes a snake. As a Bonus Action make a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet: 1d12 Piercing and Poisoned for the rest of the spell. +1d12 per slot level above 3.
Once per turn while it lasts, when you drop an Undead to 0 HP, deal 5d6 Radiant to a creature you can see within 60 feet. +1d6 per slot level above 4.

Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. You or a willing creature within 30 feet gains Advantage on Stealth checks. When it stops being Invisible, it can take a Reaction to become Invisible again for rounds equal to Hit Dice spent, ending if it attacks, deals damage, or casts a spell. One extra target per slot level above 1.

display.components: V, S, M (sand mixed with the caster's blood)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. Roll it plus 2d12: if the total equals or exceeds a creature's current HP it sleeps for 1 minute, or 24 hours if it equals or exceeds its HP maximum. Damage or a shake wakes it, and an early wake costs 1 Exhaustion level. Creatures that don't sleep or are immune to Exhaustion are unaffected. +1d12 and two more Hit Dice per slot level above 1.
A creature with Charisma 3 or higher makes a Charisma save: 8d8 Psychic and Frightened for the duration, or half damage only on success.

display.castingTime: Reaction, when you hit a creature with a Melee weapon
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend five Hit Dice or it fails. For the duration, once per turn when you hit with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, heal by a roll of the spent Hit Dice.

display.castingTime: Reaction, when a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead you can see in range drops to 0 HP
display.components: V, S, M (a gem-encrusted humanoid skull worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend nine Hit Dice or it fails. Gain temp HP equal to twice their roll and add the dying creature's type to your own until you recast or drop to 0 HP: immune to Poisoned, no need to eat, drink, or breathe, B/P/S Resistance, plus a type benefit. Celestial: Resistance to Radiant and Necrotic, fly 60. Elemental: Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder. Fey: Bonus Action Invisible until your next turn or teleport 60 feet. Fiend: Resistance to Cold and Fire, fly 60. Undead: immune to Necrotic, Charmed, and Frightened.

Ranged spell attack with invisible hands: on a hit the creature is Restrained and can't breathe. It holds its breath for 1 + Con mod rounds, then gains 1 Exhaustion each turn until it can breathe (that Exhaustion then clears). An action and an Athletics check against your DC frees it.

display.castingTime: Bonus Action, right after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike
display.description: The creature you just hit takes +4d6 Force, loses Concentration, and has its ongoing level 3 or lower spells end; for each level 4+ spell on it, make a spellcasting check against DC 10 + its level to end it.

display.castingTime: Reaction, when a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend two Hit Dice or it fails. The creature that just took damage takes extra Necrotic equal to their roll, and you gain temp HP equal to that roll plus the triggering damage, up to 15. The cap rises by 10 per slot level above 2.

A willing creature gains 3d6 temp HP in a thorny shell; a melee attacker that hits it takes Piercing equal to the temp HP the hit removed. Ends when the temp HP are gone. +2d6 temp HP per slot level above 1.

A 15-foot Emanation around you shakes (you are unaffected) and is Difficult Terrain. When it reaches a creature, or a creature enters or ends its turn in it, the creature makes a Dexterity save (once per turn) or takes 1d6 Bludgeoning and falls Prone. +1d6 per slot level above 1.

display.components: V, S, M (a pot of brackish water, a pot of grave dirt, and a black onyx worth 500+ GP per corpse)
display.description: Raise one Undead of CR 3 or lower from enough corpses. Command it within 60 feet with a Bonus Action; otherwise it Dodges. Control lasts 24 hours and recasting renews it; after 30 days of renewal it stays under your control permanently. You can hold at most four.
Your Unarmed Strikes become claws dealing 1d6 Slashing using your spellcasting modifier, and each time they deal damage you gain temp HP equal to that modifier (lost when the spell ends).

Sangromancy. Spend a Hit Die or it fails. A creature within 30 feet makes a Constitution save or takes Thunder equal to the Hit Die roll and has Disadvantage on Stealth; it repeats the save each turn to end the spell. One more Hit Die of damage per slot level above 1.

display.components: V, S, M (a bloody funerary shroud)
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend seven Hit Dice (as printed) or it fails. Melee attackers within 5 feet that hit you take Necrotic equal to a roll of those Hit Dice + your spellcasting modifier. When a Melee weapon hits you, take a Reaction: the attacker makes a Strength save or the weapon sticks to you, leaving it Grappled while it holds on (an action and Athletics check against your DC frees it). You can trap as many weapons as Hit Dice spent, plus one per slot level above 4.

display.components: V, S, M (a vial of tears)
display.description: A gray wall of grief up to 60 by 10 by 5 feet, or a ring 20 feet across and up to 20 feet high, appears on solid ground, blocks sight, and sheds Dim Light 100 feet. You and chosen creatures are unaffected. A creature that moves within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there makes a Charisma save or is Incapacitated until its next turn; one that first enters it on a turn or ends its turn inside makes a Charisma save or gains 1 Exhaustion level.

display.components: V, S, M (a mithral sewing needle worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: You sense magic within 120 feet (auras and schools) and gain thirteen threads (two more per slot level above 6); the spell ends when they run out. Spend 1 when casting to upcast by one level and gain 1 + spell level temp HP. Spend 1 as a Reaction to stop a spell cast within 120 feet (automatic for level 3 or lower, otherwise a spellcasting check against DC 10 + its level). Spend up to six on a damaging or healing spell to add 4 per thread to one creature.

display.castingTime: Bonus Action, right after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike
display.description: Sangromancy. Spend two Hit Dice or it fails. The creature you just hit loses all damage Resistances until the start of your next turn and takes extra Necrotic equal to a roll of the spent Hit Dice.

A creature you can see loses its face: Blinded, Incapacitated, and suffocating. It makes a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to end the spell. Dealing it 15 or more Slashing damage opens an airway until the start of your next turn.

display.components: V, S, M (a frayed piece of cord)
display.description: A creature makes a Constitution save or its Speed is halved and it has Disadvantage on attack rolls, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

display.components: V, S, M (a jeweled sea serpent statuette worth 300+ GP)
display.description: Summon a Sea Serpent Spirit (Large; AC 11 + spell level; HP 30 + 10 per level above 3; swim 60; Cold Resistance) with Enormous Mouth, Glowing Lantern, or Scaled Wings. It makes half the spell level (round down) attacks: Bite (1d6 + 3 + level Piercing and Grappled) or Thrash (reach 10, 1d10 + 3 + level Bludgeoning and push 5 feet). Mouth adds Inhale (15-foot Cone Strength save, Psychic damage and a pull); Lantern adds Allure (30-foot Wisdom save or Charmed); Wings add fly 40 and Flyby. It acts after you and obeys spoken commands, otherwise Dodging.

display.castingTime: Reaction, when you see an attack roll hit a creature within 60 feet
display.components: V, S, M (a drop of oil or molasses)
display.description: Chronomancy. Either the hit deals +2d6 of its damage type, or its damage is reduced by 2d6 (min 0). +1d6 per slot level above 1.

display.components: V, S, M (a magnifying glass and pipe)
display.description: Footprints and fingerprints within a 30-foot Emanation left since a moment you pick (up to 10 days back) glow, one color per creature without naming anyone. Anything that moves or touches things in the area during the spell leaves colored prints too, which can reveal invisible creatures.
Chronomancy. A creature you can see makes a Wisdom save or moves to last in the Initiative order from the next round on.

Chronomancy. Your future self sends you a warning or tip of up to six words, chosen by the GM. Later, once you understand it, you must perform a 10-minute ritual (doable during a rest) to send it back; no message means you never will. You can't cast it again for 7 days or until you perform the ritual.

A creature you can see makes a Strength save. Failure: it is pushed up to 20 feet through a window of your choice (or a conjured window of force if none is near), taking 4d6 Slashing and landing Prone. Success: pushed 10 feet, no damage. +1d6 and +5 feet per slot level above 2.

display.components: V, S, M (a small servant's bell)
display.description: A Medium or smaller Beast you touch becomes a finely dressed Humanoid Commoner (keeping its HP and Hit Dice, with a skill you choose) with 10 temp HP, acting on its own Initiative as your dutiful servant. The spell ends when the temp HP run out, or at the next midnight's twelfth stroke (24 hours where time runs strangely). One more Beast per slot level above 4.

Your hand becomes a Simple Ranged weapon (range 60/240, Slow mastery) using your spellcasting ability to hit and dealing 2d6 Force with no modifier. Range grows to 90/360 at level 5, 120/480 at 11, and 150/600 at 17.

A creature in range that understands you (Wisdom save if unwilling) must play a nonmagical game with you. The loser takes 6d6 Psychic, or both of you do if it's unfinished after an hour; harming the other side forfeits. You can agree on bigger stakes (up to 12d6 Psychic, money, property, or deeds such as titles), sealed with a handshake; the spell exposes bets that can't be paid, delivers wagered goods, and compels wagered deeds. Nothing else can influence the game.

display.components: V, S, M (a vial of strong liquor)
display.description: A creature makes a Constitution save: 3d8 Psychic and Poisoned until the end of your next turn, or half damage only on success. It has Disadvantage on the Concentration save this damage causes. +1d8 per slot level above 2.

display.components: V, S, M (a knotted silver string worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: You perfectly remember one page of text for a year, and afterward have Advantage on Intelligence checks to recall it.

Chronomancy. Time stops for everyone else while you take one Search, Study, or Utilize action and move within your space. You can't affect other creatures or objects you aren't carrying, and anything you let go freezes in time.

Chronomancy. Undo one action taken within range in the last round: its direct effects (such as damage) are reversed, but indirect ones (like where people moved) remain. The creature that took it takes 10d8 Psychic.

display.components: V, S, M (a pair of armbands)
display.description: A willing creature grows two working arcane arms that can hold weapons or Shields (up to two two-handed or four one-handed weapons) and do Somatic components. It has Advantage on Athletics checks and can make a Bonus Action melee attack with a weapon in the new arms.

Chronomancy. Mark your location. Until the end of your next turn, take a Reaction when attacked, when a creature casts a spell, or when a creature moves within 5 feet of you to teleport back there (or the nearest open space) before the trigger resolves.

Spread a rumor of up to 10 words through a 100-foot Emanation: every creature there that can hear at least three others believes it overheard someone nearby repeat it, so the source can't be traced. It shifts attitudes but rarely makes anyone Hostile.

display.components: S, M (a proficient Melee weapon worth 1+ CP)
display.description: Make one attack with the weapon, either a melee attack or a ranged spell attack out to 15 feet, using your spellcasting ability. Ranged, it deals Lightning; melee, Lightning or the weapon's type. Extra Lightning damage: 1d6 at level 5, 2d6 at 11, 3d6 at 17.

display.castingTime: Reaction, when a creature you can see in range hits with an attack roll
display.description: The attacker makes a Wisdom save or you pick: Fumble (it drops a held object of your choice up to 10 feet away; if that was its weapon it can make an Unarmed Strike instead) or Prat Fall (it falls Prone, and Prone's Disadvantage applies to the triggering attack).

display.components: S, M (a proficient Melee weapon worth 1+ CP)
display.description: Make one melee attack with the weapon using your spellcasting ability, dealing Fire or its normal type. Any damage die that rolls its maximum explodes (roll again and add), up to your spellcasting modifier in extra dice. Extra Fire damage: 1d6 at level 5, 2d6 at 11, 3d6 at 17.
Ranged spell attack: 1d8 Force, and a 5-foot square in the target's space becomes Difficult Terrain of candy for 1 minute. 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at 11, 4d8 at 17.
Until the end of your next turn, you can reroll ability checks for nonmagical games of skill, using the new roll.
Each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere makes a Wisdom save: 6d6 Psychic and Frightened for the duration (repeat save each turn), or half damage only. +1d6 per slot level above 3.

Chronomancy. Retroactively declare a preparation you made in the last 24 hours (packing gear, arranging a distraction); the GM may require a check. It can add elements but can't remove or harm creatures or move things you aren't carrying; the GM decides its limits.

display.components: V, S, M (a needle and thread)
display.description: A creature you touch heals 3d6 but its HP maximum drops by 1d6 (min 1). +2d6 healing and +1d6 reduction per slot level above 1.

display.components: V, S, M (a drop of fresh blood)
display.description: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere makes a Wisdom save or is Frenzied: it treats everyone as an enemy, picks the targets of its attacks, spells, and abilities at random among creatures it can see, and must take every Opportunity Attack offered. It repeats the save at the end of each turn.

display.components: S, M (a proficient Melee weapon worth 1+ CP)
display.description: Make one melee attack with the weapon using your spellcasting ability; a single damage die steps up one size (d12 or 2d6 at the top), and it deals Cold or its normal type. Extra Cold damage: 1d6 at level 5, 2d6 at 11, 3d6 at 17.

display.components: V, S, M (a glass slipper worth 100+ GP)
display.description: A willing creature is dressed in an unremovable ball gown and jewels. It can treat any Charisma D20 Test roll as a 10, and a creature that attacks it while seeing it makes a Wisdom save or misses (success makes that attacker immune for the spell). It lasts until the next midnight's twelfth stroke, or 24 hours where time runs strangely.

display.components: V, S, M (an ounce of salt per foot of the portal's perimeter)
display.description: An invisible eldritch guardian wards a door, window, or similar opening: anything passing through makes a Wisdom save, 4d6 Psychic or half. +1d6 per slot level above 2.

Boulders rain on a 60-foot-radius, 120-foot-high Cylinder: Dexterity save for 10d8 Bludgeoning and buried (Prone and Restrained until an action and an Athletics check against your DC frees it), or half damage only.
Melee spell attack: 6d4 Acid and -3 AC (min 10) for 1 hour. Against an unattended nonmagical metal object it eats away a 1-foot cube. +2d4 and one more cubic foot per slot level above 3.

display.components: V, S, M (a crystal ball, tarot deck, or spirit board, and incense worth 50+ GP)
display.description: With three or more willing creatures holding hands, call a named or described soul you know of; if free and willing it appears and answers up to three questions with what it knew in life, briefly and not necessarily truthfully if hostile. Fails on the same spirit within 10 days; 5% chance of reaching a deceptive wrong spirit.

display.components: V, S, M (a straw doll worth 1+ CP)
display.description: A Humanoid makes a Constitution save or part of its soul is bound to the doll (ends if the doll is destroyed or it changes planes). As a Magic action: Control (dictate its next turn's movement and Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Utilize), Harm (2d8 damage of a fitting type, ignoring Resistance and Immunity), or Restrain (dunk the doll; Restrained until the end of your next turn).
A creature you can see has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing until the end of your next turn.

display.components: V, S, M (a bird's wing feather)
display.description: A creature you touch gains a 60-foot Fly Speed with hover until the end of its next turn, then falls if unsupported.

display.components: V, S, M (a strand of horse hair)
display.description: A spectral sword hangs over each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. When one there attacks or casts a spell, you can drop its sword first: Dexterity save for 4d8 Force or half, once per turn per creature. +1d8 per slot level above 5.

display.components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes)
display.description: The next attack roll against you has a -10 penalty, then the spell ends.
Four razor feathers orbit you. On casting and as a Bonus Action later, fire one: a ranged spell attack within 120 feet for 1d8 Force. +1d8 per slot level above 1.
Gain Heroic Inspiration on casting and at the start of each of your turns if you lack it.
