Always prepared: Bane, Blindness/Deafness, Phantasmal Force, Ray of Sickness (3); Speak with Dead, Summon Undead (5); Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer (7); Antilife Shell, Cloudkill (9).

Your Necrotic damage ignores Necrotic resistance, and once per turn a damaging spell can switch to Necrotic. In Form of Dread, once per turn roll one extra damage die on a Necrotic hit. No need to eat, drink, breathe or sleep for Exhaustion purposes; magic can't put you to sleep.

Resistance to Necrotic (immunity in Form of Dread). Once per Short or Long Rest, when dropped to 0 HP, chosen creatures in a 30-foot Emanation make a Con save for 2d10 + Cha Necrotic (half on success); you return to twice your Warlock level HP and gain 1 Exhaustion.

In Form of Dread: resist Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing; Fly Speed equal to Speed (hover) and move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end inside); cast Conjuration and Necromancy Warlock spells with no V, S or non-costly M components.

You have Despairing Strike Dice: three d8s at level 3, four d10s at 10, five d12s at 15, all regained on a Short or Long Rest. Once per attack, when you hit with a weapon, spend one to add that roll as Psychic damage and optionally an effect (save DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus). Abandoned: Intelligence save or Deafened until the end of your next turn, treating every creature it sees as an enemy. Dread: Disadvantage on its next saving throw before the start of your next turn.

Darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet if you already have it). Empathetic Inquiry: as a Magic action, a creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or you learn an emotion weighing on it (a worry, love, or hate); it knows if it can see you. Wisdom modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

When you use Tactical Shift you can teleport up to 30 feet instead of moving. Right after, once per Short or Long Rest, each creature you choose in a 10-foot Emanation makes a Wisdom save: on a failure it takes Psychic damage equal to one Despairing Strike die roll and is Frightened until the end of your next turn; on a success, half damage.

New Despairing Strike options. Apathetic: Wisdom save or Incapacitated until the start of your next turn, answering only in single words. Lost: Charisma save or Blinded with Speed 0 until the end of its next turn; on a success its Speed is halved instead. Weary: Constitution save or 1 Exhaustion level (never above 2 from this), removed at the end of your next turn.

Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic damage. When an effect would reduce your Hit Point maximum, make a DC 15 Constitution save to negate it; the DC rises by 5 for each later attempt and resets to 15 on a Short or Long Rest.

When you use Action Surge, for 1 minute (or until Incapacitated): Shade Form lets you take a Reaction when hit by an attack to reduce its damage to 0, and you are immune to Charmed and Frightened (ending either if present).

While Raging you are unrecognizable to anyone who hasn't seen the change. Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 and can deal Force instead of their normal type; on a hit, push 10 feet or force a Constitution save (DC 8 + Str mod + PB) or Prone. You count as one size larger for Grapples and your Unarmed Strike reach is +5 feet.
Proficiency in one of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Persuasion, or Religion, plus one Artisan's Tools or one language.
Not Raging: Resistance to Psychic damage. Raging: Resistance to every damage type except Force and Psychic.
Not Raging: Disengage or Help as a Bonus Action. Raging: Unarmed Strikes crit on 19-20.

Once per Long Rest, when reduced to 0 HP but not killed, drop to 1 HP and gain Temporary HP equal to half your HP maximum (lost after 1 minute). If Raging, the Rage ends; if not, you start Raging even with no uses left.
While you Rage, your companion has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
Animal Friendship and Speak with Animals always prepared; each once per Short or Long Rest without a slot, or with slots. Constitution is the casting ability.

Once per Long Rest (or spend a Rage use to restore), take a Magic action to possess your companion or a Beast under your Animal Friendship within 60 feet, using its HP, Hit Dice, Str, Dex, Con, Speed and senses. Your body is catatonic. Lasts up to half your Barbarian level + Con mod hours.
Once per Short or Long Rest (or spend a Rage use), as a Bonus Action change your companion's form; its HP resets to the new maximum.

While Raging: ignore Difficult Terrain and move through creatures; +10 feet Speed and Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage; see Invisible things within 120 feet and into the Ethereal Plane.

Choose an emotion, changeable on a Long Rest. Hate: after you miss a creature, Advantage on your next attack against it before the end of your next turn. Jealousy: Reaction to impose Disadvantage on a creature's check to escape your Grapple. Terror: while Bloodied, Dash or Disengage as a Bonus Action.

Once per Rage, as a Magic action, start an aura for 1 minute; chosen creatures in it make a save at the start of their turns (DC 8 + Con or Str mod + PB) and take a number of d6 equal to your Rage Damage bonus. Contamination (10 ft., Con save): Poison damage and Poisoned. Hypothermia (10 ft., Con save): Cold damage and halved Speed. Immolation (15 ft., Dex save): Fire damage until extinguished.

Advantage on Death Saving Throws and you die only after four failures. Once per Long Rest (or spend two Rage uses), cast Cure Wounds, Revivify, or Raise Dead with no Material components, gaining 1, 2, or 3 Exhaustion levels respectively. Constitution is the casting ability.

Your Catharsis emotion adds a Raging benefit. Hate: crit on 19-20. Jealousy: Reaction when a creature starts its turn within 30 feet; Str or Dex save or Grappled until the end of its turn, or on a success its movement costs double. Terror: Reaction when a creature starts its turn within 30 feet to halve its Speed and give Opportunity Attacks against it Advantage until its next turn.

Learn one adventurer's talent, and one more at Bard levels 6 and 14. Barbarian: 1/Long Rest Bonus Action rampage for 1 minute with B/P/S Resistance (no Heavy armor, no Concentration). Cleric: 1/Short Rest Bonus Action, a creature within 30 feet gains temp HP of half your Bard level + Cha mod for 10 minutes, which it can spend on a hit as extra Radiant damage. Druid: 1/Long Rest Polymorph yourself only, max CR half your Bard level. Fighter: Martial weapons, Shields, and a Fighting Style feat. Monk: unarmored AC 10 + Dex + Cha, Dex for Unarmed Strikes, 1d6 Unarmed Strike, Bonus Action Unarmed Strike after the Attack action or an action spell. Paladin: 1/Short Rest smite with a slot, 1d6 + 1d6 per slot level Radiant (+1d6 vs Fiends and Undead). Ranger: Hunter's Mark prepared, cast at level 5 once per Long Rest without a slot. Rogue: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a Bonus Action. Sorcerer: 1/Short Rest apply one of Careful, Distant, Empowered, Extended, Seeking, Subtle, or Transmuted Spell to a Bard spell. Warlock: one Eldritch Invocation (Bard level counts). Wizard: two extra prepared Wizard spells that count as Bard spells.
A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can take the Help action as a Bonus Action.
Proficiency with one Artisan's Tools, one skill, and one language of your choice.
On a Long Rest, swap one adventurer's talent for another.

Learn Vicious Mockery (or another Bard cantrip if you have it; it doesn't count against your cantrips) and always have Dissonant Whispers prepared. After you Dash, Disengage, or Influence, you can cast Vicious Mockery as a Bonus Action.

When a creature you can see or hear within 30 feet fails a D20 Test, take a Reaction and spend a Bardic Inspiration: it takes Psychic damage equal to the roll + Cha mod and has Disadvantage on its next D20 Test before the end of its next turn.

When a creature within 60 feet drops to 0 HP or dies, take a Reaction to regain a Bardic Inspiration use; a creature within 30 feet that hears you makes a Wisdom save or is Prone with Speed 0 until the end of its next turn. If it succeeds you keep this feature; otherwise once per Short or Long Rest.

Once per Long Rest, when you become Bloodied or take damage while Bloodied, take a Reaction to regain all Bardic Inspiration and gain Resistance to all damage for 1 minute. During that minute, when a creature within 60 feet hits you, spend up to three Inspiration dice: it makes a Charisma save or takes Psychic damage equal to the dice + Cha mod.
Learn two Necromancy cantrips; they count as Bard spells and don't count against your cantrips known.

A creature with your Bardic Inspiration die can use it either when dropped to 0 HP (not killed), going to HP equal to the roll instead, or right after hitting with an attack, adding the roll as Necrotic damage.

Animate Dead is always prepared. When you spend Bardic Inspiration, up to Cha mod (min 1) Undead you control within 60 feet each gain an Inspiration die (outside your limit). Undead that spend one on a hit also add it to damage.
Once per Long Rest (or spend a Bardic Inspiration use), a single-target Necromancy spell you cast can target a second creature in range.
Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Detect Thoughts, Tasha's Hideous Laughter, See Invisibility, Sleep; 5 Fear, Tongues; 7 Confusion, Phantasmal Killer; 9 Contact Other Plane, Dream.

When you cast a slot spell with a Magic action that targets creatures, one target makes a Wisdom save or suffers a d8 Eldritch Effect for 1 minute (repeat save each turn; ends if you use this again): 1 can't speak or cast Verbal spells; 2 1d6 Psychic each turn; 3 falls Prone if it moves more than 5 feet; 4 Disadvantage on attacks and Perception; 5 action or Bonus Action, not both, and one attack; 6 Advantage on its attacks and on attacks against it; 7 Deafened and can't see beyond 30 feet; 8 Frightened.
Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: roll an Eldritch Effect; each creature in a 15-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet makes a Wisdom save or suffers it for 1 minute (repeat save each turn).

Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened. Your thoughts can't be read without permission; a creature that tries makes a Wisdom save or takes Psychic damage equal to your Cleric level.

name: Sing the Song that Ends the World
spoken: sing the song that ends the world

display.description: A creature that fails its save against Prophecy of Doom can take 10d10 Psychic damage; it is then immune to this for 10 minutes.
Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 See Invisibility, Silence; 5 Dispel Magic, Remove Curse; 7 Arcane Eye, Locate Creature; 9 Creation, Hallow.

Wisdom modifier times (min 1) per Long Rest, when you hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike, add 1d8 Force (2d8 against a concentrating target); at Cleric 14 these become 2d8 and 3d8. If the target then fails its Concentration save, you gain temp HP equal to the extra damage.

Spend a Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action: a creature within 30 feet (or you) gains 1d10 + Cleric level temp HP for 10 minutes; while it has them it has Advantage on saves against spells and Resistance to spell damage.

Wisdom modifier times (min 1) per Long Rest, take a Reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell with a Magic action: Constitution save or 1d8 Force plus 1d8 per slot level (cantrips count as level 1), half on a success.
Spell Shield can target up to your Wisdom modifier (min 1) creatures.
Wis mod + PB times (min 1) per Short or Long Rest, add 1d8 Fire to cantrip damage or a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit.
Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Detect Poison and Disease, Flame Blade; 5 Fear, Flash Fever; 7 Aura of Purity, Wall of Fire; 9 Flame Strike, Hold Monster.

On a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend a Channel Divinity to brand the target instead of dealing normal damage: for 1 minute it has Disadvantage on saves against your spells and Vulnerability to your Fire damage, even if it resists or is immune.

Advantage on saves against disease and against effects that change your form. As a Magic action, grant this to a willing creature for 1 hour; it takes Fire damage equal to your Wis mod (min 1), ignoring Resistance and Immunity.
Cast Lesser Restoration and Greater Restoration on a willing creature with no slot and no Material components; it takes 1d6 Fire per spell level, ignoring Resistance and Immunity.
Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Blood Rush, Crimson Lash, Sense Lifeblood; 5 Blood Bond, Sanguine Poppet; 7 Circle of Scarlet, Dark Sacrament; 9 Dominate Person, Mortality.
Spend a Wild Shape use as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: gain temp HP equal to 3 x Druid level, +10 feet Speed and Dash as a Bonus Action, and your weapon or Unarmed Strike hits can add 1d6 Necrotic.

Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest (one back on a Short Rest), when a creature within 60 feet drops to 0 HP, take a Reaction to regain 1 Hit Die and give a creature within 60 feet temp HP equal to your Druid level.
During Blood Moon your extra Necrotic becomes 2d6 and you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
Once per Long Rest, a Blood Boon instead restores Hit Dice equal to half your Druid level and gives up to Wis mod creatures within 60 feet temp HP equal to twice your Druid level.

After each Short or Long Rest pick one until the next rest. Elemental Cataclysm: Magic action, spend a slot for a 10-foot-radius Sphere within 60 feet; Dex save, 1d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning per slot level and Vulnerability to that type for 1 minute (repeat save each turn), half and no Vulnerability on a success. Ruinous Smite: once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend a slot for 1d8 + 1d8 per slot level Necrotic. Weapon Mastery: use the mastery property of one proficient weapon kind, changeable on a Long Rest.
Spend a Wild Shape use as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Advantage on attacks against Bloodied creatures, two attacks per Attack action, and base AC 17 + Wis mod if higher.
During Ruin Incarnate, your weapon and Unarmed Strike hits can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Necrotic instead, and you add Wis mod (min +1) to Strength and Dexterity saves.

Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action grow one size for 10 minutes; each creature in a 30-foot Emanation makes a Dex save or falls Prone, and grounded structures there take Druid-level d10 Bludgeoning. While enlarged, weapon and Unarmed Strike hits deal +1d4.
Creatures hit by your Ruinous Smite suffer crits on 19-20 until the end of your next turn; Ruin Incarnate gives three attacks per Attack action; Shake the Earth recharges on a Short or Long Rest.

On entering Wild Shape, or as a Bonus Action in it, spend a slot to gain Mutation Points equal to its level and spend them on mutations (each once per Wild Shape unless repeatable) until you leave the form. Sea (1, +1 for double): swim speed and water breathing. Sky (3, +2 for 60 ft.): fly 30 ft. Darkvision (1): 60 ft. or +60. Disquieting Voice (1): talk with and Influence Beasts. Echolocation (3): Blindsight 30 ft. Enlarge (2, +2 for two sizes). Manipulate Objects (1): Utilize as a Bonus Action. Multiattack (2): two form attacks per Attack action. Natural Armor (2): +1 AC, up to three times. Reduce (1, +2 for two sizes). Venomous Attacks (2): once per turn +2d6 Poison and Con save or Poisoned 1 minute, up to three times for +2d6 each. Wall Crawler (1, +1 for double): climb speed.

Spending a level 2+ slot on Mutation Points returns one lower-level slot (max level 5). In Wild Shape your attacks can deal Force instead, and you have Advantage on Deception, Intimidation, and Animal Handling checks.

Gain extra Mutation Points equal to Wis mod (min 1). New mutations: Creature of Earth (3, +2 for burrow): Tremorsense 30 ft. Elemental Inurement (2): Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder, repeatable for different types. Eldritch Assault (2): +1 to form attack and damage, up to three times. Mystic Monster (3): cast spells in Wild Shape, and at Druid 18 targets have Disadvantage on saves against them. Rapid Regeneration (5): regain Wis mod HP each turn. Supernatural Hide (5): B/P/S Resistance.

Once per turn a form attack hit deals +2d10 Force. As a Magic action, touch a Beast and spend a slot to give it mutations worth the slot level; they last until replaced or ended by Remove Curse or Greater Restoration.
Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn (one taunt per creature).
Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Bonus Action for 1 minute, gain temp HP equal to Fighter level + Con mod at the end of each of your turns.

Twice per Long Rest (three times at Fighter 15), as a Magic action, chosen creatures that can hear you in a 30-foot Emanation make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Con mod + PB) or take 5d6 Psychic and have Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you. Using it restores Weather the Storm.
Once on each of your turns, when you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend up to half your Fighter level in temp HP to add that much damage.
When Second Wind heals you, you also gain temp HP equal to the roll's total.
When a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, take a Reaction to become the target instead, with Resistance to all of that attack's damage.

Learn three compounds (two more at Fighter 7, 10, and 15, swapping one each time). On a Long Rest with Alchemist's Supplies, make any number; they vanish at the next Long Rest. Drink one as a Bonus Action, up to 1 + Con mod (min 1) per Long Rest; repeats of the same compound don't stack, and anyone else who drinks one makes a Con save (DC 8 + Int mod + PB) or is Poisoned for 1 minute. Options: Adrenal Injection (+10 ft. Speed and a 30-ft. jump for 10 ft. of movement, 1 minute); Allsense Injection (Blindsight 30 ft., 1 minute); Arcane Eye Oil (sense magic within 30 ft., 1 hour); six Draughts (Advantage on checks and saves of one ability, 10 minutes); Elfsight Oil (Darkvision 120 ft., 8 hours); Fleshknit Phosphate (regain PB HP each turn, 1 minute); Ironmind Injection (Advantage against Charmed and Frightened, 1 hour); Liquid Courage (temp HP 2 x Fighter level + Con mod); Liquid Rage (+1d4 weapon and Unarmed Strike damage, 1 minute); Presto Powder (Advantage on Initiative and Bonus Action Dash or Disengage, 10 minutes); Spellshine Ointment (Resistance to Force, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, 1 minute); Steelskin Ointment (B/P/S Resistance, 1 minute); Tenmen Tincture (one size larger for carrying, and swap a weapon's mastery for Topple, 1 hour).
You gain Alchemist's Supplies and proficiency with them, with double Proficiency Bonus on their checks.
You can safely drink 3 + Con mod compounds per Long Rest (5 + Con mod at Fighter 18).
When you drink a compound as a Bonus Action, you can drink a second one.
Resistance to Poison damage. As a Bonus Action end Poisoned on yourself; once per Long Rest doing so grants temp HP equal to your Fighter level.
On a Long Rest, swap one known compound for another.
Expertise in one skill you're proficient in, plus proficiency in two of Deception, History, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, or Stealth.

Darkvision 60 feet (or +60). Advantage on Initiative and Wisdom (Perception). Warning Shout: once per Long Rest, when you roll Initiative, take a Reaction so chosen creatures within 30 feet can each use a Reaction to gain Advantage on Initiative and move half their Speed without provoking.

As a Bonus Action, mark a creature within 30 feet until the start of your next turn; when it attacks you or someone within 5 feet of you, take a Reaction to give that roll Disadvantage and the target Resistance to its damage.
Once per Short or Long Rest, Bonus Action Blindsight 30 feet for 10 minutes. Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage, and you don't provoke them while entirely in Dim Light or Darkness.
Treat Initiative d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10. On an Initiative roll of 18-20, take one extra action (not Magic) on your first turn.
Right after you miss a creature you've Sized Up, use a Bonus Action or Reaction to make a melee attack against it with Advantage.
On your turn your Unarmed Strike reach is +5 feet, and Unarmed Strikes from the Attack action can deal Psychic damage.

Learn Mage Hand, cast without Verbal or Somatic components, and its hand can be Invisible. As a Magic action, spend 1 Focus Point to cast Detect Evil and Good or Protection from Evil and Good, or 2 to cast Hold Person, Levitate, or Shatter (Wisdom, no Material components).
Once on each of your turns when you hit with an Unarmed Strike or Monk weapon, the target makes a Strength save against your Focus save DC or you move it up to 10 feet toward or away from you.

Each Unarmed Strike hit gives the target a Pressure Point (lost after 1 minute or when you mark another creature). Bonus Action, 1 Focus Point: it makes a Strength save; failure deals 1d8 Force per Point and Restrained until the end of your next turn, success half damage.
As a Magic action, spend 5 Focus Points to cast Dispel Evil and Good, Hold Monster, Telekinesis, or Wall of Force (Wisdom, no Material components).
Proficiency in Deception, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion.
When you spend a Focus Point, gain temp HP equal to Wis mod (min 1), doubled while Bloodied.
While Bloodied, add Wis mod to Unarmed Strike and Monk weapon damage.
When a creature damages you, take a Reaction and spend 1 Focus Point to gain Advantage on attacks against it until the end of your next turn.
When you crit while Bloodied, roll one extra damage die.

When dropped to 0 HP but not killed, spend 1 Focus Point to enter a trance: immune to Unconscious, can't speak or cast or concentrate, and a crit counts as only one failed Death Save. Spend 1 Focus Point each turn you start at 0 HP to keep it; you still make Death Saves.
You count as Bloodied whenever you are below your Hit Point maximum.

Once per turn, spend 1 Focus Point (no action) to create an intangible shade within 10 feet until the end of your next turn. Flurry of Blows attacks can originate from it, dealing Necrotic or Force. Move it up to 60 feet as a Bonus Action.
When you Dash, you can instead teleport yourself or an ally within 60 feet to your shade's location.
Help as a Bonus Action, or spend 1 Focus Point to touch a creature and heal one Martial Arts die + Wis mod.
Spend 3 Focus Points: chosen creatures in a 20-foot Emanation from you or your shade make a Wisdom save; failure deals three Martial Arts dice Psychic and Prone, success half damage.
Your shade lasts 10 minutes, makes one extra Unarmed Strike after Flurry of Blows, and can deliver Stunning Strike.
On a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend a Channel Divinity: the target is Poisoned and Incapacitated for 1 minute, repeating a Constitution save each turn.

Magic action, spend a Channel Divinity on a creature within 30 feet: for 1 minute your damage to it adds 2d6 Necrotic and it loses Necrotic Resistance and Immunity (Constitution save each turn ends it).
Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Bane, Inflict Wounds; 5 Melf's Acid Arrow, Ray of Enfeeblement; 9 Flash Fever, Stinking Cloud; 13 Blight, Confusion; 17 Contagion, Insect Plague.
When a creature in your Aura of Protection is about to make a D20 Test, take a Reaction to give it Disadvantage.

When dropped to 0 HP but not killed, spend and roll Hit Dice to reduce the damage by the total. If you die, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation makes a Constitution save, taking 8d6 Necrotic or half on a success.

Once per Long Rest (or spend a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: immune to Poison and Poisoned, Resistance to Necrotic, HP maximum can't be reduced, and enemies starting their turn in your aura take Necrotic equal to Cha mod + PB.

Spend a Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to frenzy until the end of your next turn: when you miss with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, take a Reaction to attack again, and Advantage on saves against Charmed, Frightened, and Stunned. Extend it each turn by attacking an enemy, forcing an enemy's save, or ending your turn Bloodied, up to 1 minute; it ends if you're Incapacitated.
Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Crimson Lash, Inflict Wounds; 5 Bloodletter, Shatter; 9 Fear, Suffocate; 13 Consume Mind, Supernal Smite; 17 Destructive Wave, Incite Riot.

Bloodied allies in your Aura of Protection add your Cha mod to weapon and Unarmed Strike damage. Take a Reaction to give a Bloodied creature in the aura Disadvantage on a save against a Sangromancy spell.
When a creature in your Aura of Protection becomes Bloodied, take a Reaction to move half your Speed without provoking and make a melee attack with Advantage.

Once per Long Rest (or spend a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: gain 30 temp HP whenever an enemy Bloodies a creature in your aura; take a Reaction to attack a creature that hits you; and on a melee hit, chosen creatures within 5 feet of the target and in your reach take Force equal to Cha mod (min 1) + PB.

Spend a Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute: your weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks against it crit on 19-20, and when it starts its turn in your reach you can take a Reaction to attack it.
Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Detect Evil and Good, Hunter's Mark; 5 Detect Thoughts, Knock; 9 Fear, Tongues; 13 Divination, Locate Creature; 17 Insect Plague, Scrying.
You and allies in your Aura of Protection are immune to Blinded there, and you see Invisible creatures in it.
Cast Zone of Truth without a slot. A creature that succeeds on its save takes 1d6 Psychic at the start of each of its turns in the zone until it chooses to fail.

Once per Long Rest (or spend a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: enemies starting their turn within 5 feet make a Constitution save or are Blinded until their next turn; Truesight 60 feet; and as a Bonus Action pick a creature within 60 feet that you and allies attack with Advantage.
Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action, poison a weapon or up to 20 ammunition for 1 minute: +1d4 Poison on hits. At Ranger 11, 2d4 and uses return on a Short or Long Rest.

Poisoner's Kit with proficiency and double PB on its checks; rebuild a lost kit with an hour of foraging during a rest. Once per turn when your weapon deals Poison damage, spend a slot for +1d6 Poison and Poisoned until the end of your next turn, plus a Toxin Effect by slot level. Level 1: Attenuate (Disadvantage on Str and Dex saves), Befuddled (can't speak, read or write; Disadvantage on Concentration), Uncoordinated (no Reactions, Disengage, or Dodge). Level 2: Debilitate (no healing 1 minute), Potent (loses Poison Resistance 1 minute), Suffer (+1d6 the first Poison damage each turn for 1 minute). Level 3: Lingering (Poisoned 10 minutes, save each turn with Disadvantage), Supernatural (loses Poisoned Immunity and is Poisoned 1 minute). Level 4: Flesh Eating (Poisoned 1 minute, 2d6 Acid each turn), Insensate (also Blinded and Deafened), Paraplegia (Speed 0, Disadvantage on Dex saves). Level 5: Enhanced (a level 4 effect plus a level 1 or 2 effect) or Stinging Application (once per turn +5d6 Acid, Necrotic, or Poison for 1 minute).
Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Detect Poison and Disease; 5 Hold Person; 9 Bestow Curse; 13 Greater Invisibility; 17 Cloudkill.
Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves against Poisoned. Cast Protection from Poison without a slot Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest.
Your weapon Poison damage can be Acid or Necrotic instead.
Just before a creature within 60 feet damages you, take a Reaction to gain temp HP equal to that damage; leftovers vanish at the end of your next turn.

Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action imbue a Longbow or Shortbow for 1 minute: it deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder instead of its normal type plus 1d6 of that type. You can switch type at the start of each turn.
Herbalism Kit with proficiency. Use it as a Bonus Action to stabilize a creature at 0 HP within 5 feet without a check; once per Short or Long Rest, a Utilize action instead brings it to 1 HP.
Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Hex; 5 Blindness/Deafness; 9 Call Lightning; 13 Polymorph; 17 Wall of Stone.
After an hour's work or a Long Rest with an Herbalism Kit, gain Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder until your next Long Rest.

Once per turn when you hit with a Longbow or Shortbow, spend a slot for an effect; damage +2d6 per slot level above 1. Arcing Shot: attack a second creature within 30 feet, each hit takes 2d6 Lightning. Entangling Shot: Strength save or 2d6 Piercing and Restrained 1 minute (repeat save). Hexing Shot: Wisdom save or 2d6 Psychic and Charmed or Frightened 1 minute (repeat save), half on success. Viper Shot: Constitution save or 2d6 Poison and Poisoned 1 minute (repeat save), half on success.

Damage can't break Concentration on your Ranger spells. Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action switch your Weave the Elements type and force a creature within 30 feet to make a Constitution save or take 6d6 of either type.

Talk with Tiny Beasts. Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action spend a slot to summon as many Swarms of Vermin as its level for 1 hour (AC 11 + slot level, HP 5 + 10 per slot level, B/P/S Resistance, Pack Tactics, Bites using your spell attack for 2d6 + 1 + slot level Piercing). They act on your turn and Dodge unless you command them all with one Bonus Action.
Wis mod + PB times per Short or Long Rest, a Bonus Action command makes all your swarms attack, or one swarm attack twice.
Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Consumption; 5 Animal Messenger; 9 Flash Fever; 13 Freedom of Movement; 17 Contagion.
Immune to the Poisoned condition and proficient in Constitution saves.
With Swarming Strikes each attacking swarm makes one more attack, and creatures they damage are Poisoned until the start of your next turn.
When a creature within 10 feet damages you, take a Reaction to redirect the damage to one of your swarms within 5 feet.

Proficiency with Blackpowder Pistols. When you roll Initiative without Disadvantage, take a Reaction to attack once, move your Speed without provoking, have your controlled mount move its Speed without provoking, or Dodge or Utilize.
Find Steed always prepared; once per Long Rest cast it with no slot or components, using Intelligence.
You don't need Advantage for Sneak Attack if you or your controlled mount moved at least 20 feet and you don't have Disadvantage.
Spend 1 minute grooming your mount to give it temp HP equal to twice your Rogue level. A mount you control can Dash, Disengage, or Dodge as a Bonus Action.
Proficiency in Constitution saves; against half-damage Constitution saves you take none on a success and half on a failure.
When dropped to 0 HP but not killed, you can use Hair Trigger before falling Unconscious.
As a Bonus Action curse a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute (one at a time); you can Sneak Attack it whenever you don't have Disadvantage.

Learn two Misfortunes (one more at Rogue 9, 13, and 17; swap one per Long Rest). You have 4 Jinx Points (6 at Rogue 13), regained on a Short or Long Rest; save DC 8 + Cha or Int mod + PB. Most end the Evil Eye curse when used. Befuddled (2, Magic action): Wis save or Charmed 10 minutes. Clumsy (3, Reaction when it moves): Prone and Speed 0. Debilitated (1, Reaction when it takes damage): +1d12 Necrotic. Doomed (1, Reaction): reroll your missed attack. Fearful (2, Magic action): Wis save or Frightened 1 minute. Inept (1, Reaction): it rerolls a D20 Test. Insensate (3, Magic action): Wis save or Blinded and Deafened 1 minute. Maimed (2, Reaction): your hit on a 19 becomes a crit. Marked (2, Bonus Action): Evil Eye lasts 1 hour and you sense its direction. Plagued (1, Reaction): halve its healing and block healing until your next turn. Somnolent (3, Magic action): Wis save or Unconscious 1 minute. Unlucky (3, Bonus Action): subtract 1d4 from its attacks and saves while cursed.
Once per Short or Long Rest, when a creature within 30 feet is about to roll a D20 Test with Advantage, take a Reaction to cancel the Advantage and regain 1 Jinx Point.
Spend 3 Jinx Points as a Magic action to cast Bestow Curse.
Steal Luck works three times per Long Rest.
You have a pool of Sangromancy Dice (d8s) equal to your Sneak Attack dice, refilled on a Long Rest. Spend them instead of Hit Dice when casting Sangromancy spells.
Int mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, when you deal Sneak Attack damage restore 1 Sangromancy Die, or while Bloodied roll it and heal that much instead.

On a Long Rest spend up to 2 Hit Dice or Sangromancy Dice to make that many Daggers that last until your next Long Rest. They work as Arcane Foci (and allow Somatic components), and a crit with one adds Necrotic d8s equal to the dice spent.

Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action spend 3 Hit Dice or Sangromancy Dice: chosen creatures in a 30-foot Emanation make a Dex save, 3d8 Necrotic or half. Regain one die per creature it drops to 0 HP.

Once per Short or Long Rest, when hit by an attack take a Reaction and spend 5 Hit Dice or Sangromancy Dice: the attack misses, you teleport up to 30 feet, and you can make a melee attack that deals +5d8 Necrotic on a hit.
Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Augury, Comprehend Languages, Hellish Rebuke, Ray of Enfeeblement; 5 Bestow Curse, Revivify; 7 Banishment, Divination; 9 Contagion, Insect Plague.

Calligrapher's Supplies proficiency; scribe Spell Scrolls in half the time and cost. You can ensorcell a scroll by spending a slot of its level or higher and Sorcery Points for a Metamagic option: anyone who knows a language can use it and gets that Metamagic. It lasts until used or your next Long Rest.
While Innate Sorcery is active: Resistance to Force damage, immunity to Frightened, and once per activation use an Action-casting-time Spell Scroll as a Bonus Action.
On each Long Rest create one free Spell Scroll of a level 5 or lower spell you can cast; it crumbles at your next Long Rest.

When you cast a Sorcerer spell with a slot, pick one. Excessive: skip a costly Material component and take 4 x slot level Force damage (ignores Resistance). Inexorable: damage can't break Concentration on it, and you gain 1 Exhaustion when it ends. Pyrrhic: its attack automatically hits as a crit, and your HP maximum drops by 4 x slot level until a Long Rest.

Once per Long Rest (or 6 Sorcery Points), as a Magic action chosen creatures in a 30-foot Emanation make a Wisdom save: 6d6 Psychic plus 6d6 Force and Frightened 1 minute (repeat save), half on success. A creature this drops to 0 HP can be revived only by True Resurrection or Wish.
Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Bane, Chill Touch, Invisibility, See Invisibility, Unseen Servant; 5 Fly, Speak with Dead; 7 Death Ward, Greater Invisibility; 9 Little Death, Telekinesis.
Add your Cha mod to Initiative rolls.

Learn Find Familiar and cast it as a Magic action with no slot; the familiar is an Undead Specter. As a Magic action it turns Invisible (leaving no trace) until it attacks or you cast through it. You can give up one of your attacks to let it use Life Drain with its Reaction.
The familiar gains 4 x Sorcerer level HP maximum, you can cast spells as if from its space, and after casting a spell with your action you can command its Life Drain as a Bonus Action.
Resistance to Necrotic damage; your damaging Sorcerer spells can deal Necrotic instead.

Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action your familiar tries to possess a creature within 5 feet of it: Charisma save or it controls the body for 1 minute (using the host's HP, Hit Dice, Str, Dex, Con, Speed, senses), obeying your telepathic commands within 100 feet. The host repeats the save whenever it takes damage. On a success it can't try that creature again for 24 hours.

Once per Long Rest, when dropped to 0 HP but not killed, drop to 1 HP and gain temp HP equal to half your HP maximum. While they last you have Resistance to all damage, fly 30 feet (hover), move through creatures, and at the start of each turn lose 10 temp HP while chosen creatures within 30 feet take 10 Necrotic.
Once per Short or Long Rest (or 1 Sorcery Point), as a Bonus Action a creature within 30 feet has Disadvantage on its next D20 Test before the start of your next turn.

Detect Evil and Good always prepared; once per Short or Long Rest cast it without a slot. Choose Fey, Fiend, or Undead as your ancestral curser: while you concentrate on it, those creatures have Disadvantage on attacks against you and can't possess, Charm, or Frighten you.

Pick one. Hulking: Disadvantage on Stealth to move quietly, +1 HP per Sorcerer level, one size larger for carrying. Nocturnal: Disadvantage on sight-based Perception in sunlight, see normally in Dim Light and Darkness (even magical) within 120 feet. Plaguebearer: Disadvantage on Persuasion with Indifferent Humanoids within 5 feet, immune to Poisoned, Resistance to Necrotic.
Bestow Curse always prepared; cast it for 3 Sorcery Points instead of a slot, with no Concentration and 60-foot range.

Once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes; a Magic action makes chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Wisdom save or be Frightened until the end of your next turn. Plus by curser: Fey, Bonus Action teleport 30 feet; Fiend, Resistance to Cold and Fire; Undead, Reaction to reduce non-Radiant damage by half your Sorcerer level.

As a Magic action spend 5 Sorcery Points to summon for 10 minutes a Lamia or Troll (Fey), Barbed Devil, Incubus, or Succubus (Fiend), or Ghost or Wraith (Undead). It acts right after you and obeys your spoken commands, otherwise Dodging.

Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Hold Person, Identify, Locate Object, Ray of Sickness; 5 Bestow Curse, Counterspell; 7 Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph; 9 Divination, Locate Creature; 17 Contact Other Plane, Scrying.

You carry a Hag's Eye that works as an Arcane Focus (your Hag sees through it). While you have it, cast Hex without a slot Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, and from Warlock 10 cast Bestow Curse once per Long Rest without a slot.

Learn Minor Illusion (or another Warlock cantrip if you have it; it doesn't count against your cantrips). Take a Reaction to give Disadvantage to a Study check against your illusion. Cha mod times (min 1) per Short or Long Rest, when a creature first sees through your illusion spell with a Study check, it takes 1d6 + 1d6 per slot level Psychic.

Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action for 1 minute. Horrifying Gaze (Bonus Action): a Humanoid within 30 feet that can see you makes a Wisdom save with Disadvantage or is Frightened 1 minute (repeat save). Paralyzing Gaze (Magic action): a Frightened Humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is Paralyzed; on success it takes Necrotic equal to your Warlock level and is freed. Death Gaze (Magic action): a Paralyzed Humanoid saves with Advantage or drops to 0 HP; on success it takes twice your Warlock level Necrotic and is freed. A creature that succeeds is immune until your next Long Rest.

Once per Long Rest, spend a slot to turn a vessel into a Hag's Cauldron for 10 minutes and pour three Common, two Uncommon, or one Rare potion (they fade at your next rest). On a Long Rest you can also spend a slot to turn a 10 GP gem into a Minor Heartstone for 24 hours: immunity to Poisoned and one Blink without a slot.

After the Attack or Magic action, make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action dealing 1d6 + Cha mod Necrotic. On a hit you can spend a Pact slot for +1d8 + 1d8 per slot level Necrotic, healing that much.
Darkvision 60 feet, or +60 if you already have it.
Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Bane, Command, False Life, Fog Cloud; 5 Conjure Animals (bats, rats, or wolves only), Gaseous Form; 7 Dominate Person, Seeming; 9 Little Death, Telekinesis.

Polymorph always prepared; Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest cast it on yourself only, with no slot or Material component, becoming a Bat, Rat, or Wolf while keeping your HP, Hit Dice, mental scores, features, and proficiencies.
Once per Long Rest, when Drain Life drops an enemy to 0 HP, take a Reaction to regain one Pact slot.

You stop aging and gain Resistance to Necrotic. Once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: regain 1d6 HP at the start of each turn (not in sunlight or running water, or after Radiant damage), and Drain Life deals +1d8 Necrotic without a slot.

Right after a creature within 60 feet casts a spell, take a Reaction: it makes a Charisma save or can't cast that spell for 8 hours, and if it was level 1+ and a level you can cast, you have it prepared meanwhile. You hold up to 1 + Cha mod spell levels; you lose them if Incapacitated, dead, or after a Long Rest.

Once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action pick up to Cha mod (min 1) benefits until your next Long Rest (swap one per Short Rest): +Warlock level HP maximum; Darkvision 60 (or +60); +5 feet Speed; Advantage on saves against Poisoned; triple jump and climb speed; add Cha mod to Athletics or Acrobatics.
You can't be surprised, have Advantage on Initiative, and Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened.

Dominate Person always prepared and castable once per Long Rest without a slot. Damage can't break your Concentration on it, and a creature that succeeds on its save takes Psychic damage equal to your Warlock level.

Once per Long Rest, when you die a parasite (Rat stat block with your HP, Hit Dice, mental scores, features; no spells) bursts out under your control. As a Magic action it can burrow into a Humanoid within 5 feet (Str or Dex save; Piercing equal to Warlock level), where it is untouchable except by Psychic damage. Each of the host's turns it can use its action on a Con save to expel it; otherwise it takes twice your Warlock level Necrotic at the end of its turn, and if that kills it you take over the body as with Reincarnate.

On each Long Rest choose Arch Daemons or Arch Seraphs and you can prepare only that side's free spellbook spells. Arch Daemon at Wizard levels 3 Bane, Toll the Dead; 5 Fear; 7 Dark Sacrament; 9 Geas. Arch Seraph: 3 Aid, Bless, Word of Radiance; 5 Revivify; 7 Guardian of Faith; 9 Greater Restoration.
Gain one Eldritch Invocation (two more at Wizard 6 and 14), using Wizard level for prerequisites and Intelligence instead of Charisma; swap one each Wizard level.

Siphoning Daemons: Resistance to Necrotic and mutual understanding with Fiends. Siphoning Seraphs: Resistance to Radiant and mutual understanding with Celestials. Once per Long Rest switch sides as a Bonus Action.
Once per Long Rest (or a level 5+ slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Advantage on Charisma checks, your Fair and Foul spells cast one slot level higher, and fly 60 feet.

Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet makes a Charisma save: 4d10 Necrotic plus 4d10 Radiant and Blinded until the end of its next turn, or half on success. You may switch sides and regain one Wizard slot of level 5 or lower.

Proficiency in Medicine, Herbalism Kit, and Alchemist's Supplies. With 10 minutes' work or a rest and a kit, spend a slot per potion to bottle a single-target spell from your spellbook of that level or lower. A creature drinks or administers one as a Bonus Action and becomes the spell's target (concentrating itself if needed). They last until your next Long Rest or next use.
Instead of a spell, a slot can make Good Medicine: the drinker heals 1d8 per slot level, and a level 3+ dose also ends Poisoned.

A slot can make Bad Medicine with one effect per slot level: Poisoned; Speed halved; +1d4 Necrotic the first time it takes damage each turn; 1d6 Poison whenever it takes an action, Bonus Action, or Reaction; Acid equal to slot level each turn. Throw it as a Magic action at a point within 30 feet: creatures within 10 feet make a Con save or suffer one effect for 1 minute (an action to repeat the save).
After taking Necrotic or Poison damage, gain that much temp HP. Immune to Poisoned.
Good Medicine heals +2d8. Bad Medicine Acid deals +2d8, and targets save with Disadvantage.
Sangromancy spells count as Wizard spells. Add two of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.
A pool of 1 + Wizard level Sangromancy Dice (d12s) you can spend instead of Hit Dice for Sangromancy spells; regain one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest.
+6 HP maximum, plus 1 per later Wizard level. Casting a Sangromancy spell with a slot heals you by the slot level.
Once per turn when your Wizard spell damages creatures, spend a Hit Die or Sangromancy Die to add its roll to one target's damage (roll twice and take the higher against a Bloodied target).
Once per Long Rest, finishing a Short Rest restores Hit Dice and Sangromancy Dice equal to half your Wizard level.

Advantage on Intimidation checks to convince people you are a wizard. When someone questions your magic, take a Reaction to Rage until the end of your next turn without spending a use (it can't be extended).

Once per turn when you hit with a Strength-based attack, add one. Mage Hand: push a Large or smaller target 5 feet (10 while Raging). Shocking Grasp: it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the end of this turn (until your next turn while Raging). True Strike: +1d6 of the attack's type (plus half your Barbarian level while Raging).

While Raging, each once per Long Rest. Burning Hands: as an action, Unarmed Strike every creature in reach for 1d8 + Str mod Bludgeoning and Disadvantage on its next attack. Magic Missile: as an action, three Strength thrown-weapon attacks with Advantage. Shield: Reaction when hit to don a Shield, adding its AC against the attack and reducing damage by your Barbarian level if it still hits.
While Raging, Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects.
Once per Rage, replace one attack with an Unarmed Strike at Advantage dealing 6d6 + Str mod Bludgeoning and knocking a Huge or smaller target Prone.
Advantage on attack rolls during the first round of combat.

Gain Heroic Inspiration when you deal damage a creature is Vulnerable to, trigger a creature's specific weakness, correctly guess a non-Humanoid creature's kind before seeing it, find a secret door, detect or disarm a trap, or find an Uncommon or better magic item or 100+ GP treasure.
Five times per Long Rest, cast Alarm, Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Detect Poison and Disease, Find Traps, Identify, or Purify Food and Drink without a slot, using Int, Wis, or Cha.
Once per turn, a weapon hit on an Aberration, Dragon, Fey, Fiend, Monstrosity, Ooze, or Undead deals +1d10 of the weapon's type.
Against half-damage Str, Dex, or Con saves you take none on a success and half on a failure, unless Incapacitated.
You can hold two Heroic Inspirations (one per roll), and once per turn spend one to turn a D20 Test into a 20 instead of rerolling.
When an Unarmed Strike hits and deals damage, spend 1 Focus Point: your Unarmed Strikes get +2 to hit this turn, rising by 2 per further hit (max +6). Taking damage or missing resets it to +2.
Your Unarmed Strikes against objects are always Critical Hits.

1 Focus Point each. Energy Blast: replace an attack; a creature within 60 feet makes a Dex save for two Martial Arts dice Force, half on success. Guard Breaker: after missing with an Unarmed Strike, deal Dex mod damage anyway and keep your Combo bonus. Uppercut: after an Unarmed Strike hits, push 5 feet and knock a Large or smaller target Prone.
On your turn spend 1 Focus Point to fly at your Speed until the end of your next turn and gain Advantage on your next melee attack this turn.
Once per Short or Long Rest (or 5 Focus Points), an Unarmed Strike hit adds three Martial Arts dice Force; if the target is left at 100 HP or fewer it is Unconscious for 10 minutes.

Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Charm Person, Hideous Laughter; 5 Enhance Ability, Hangover; 9 Create Food and Water, Hypnotic Pattern; 13 Charm Monster, Freedom of Movement; 17 Geas, Telepathic Bond.

Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action to conjure up to Cha mod (min 1) mugs of ale within 30 feet (gone after a Long Rest). Drinking one as a Bonus Action grants temp HP equal to your Cha mod and Advantage on saves for 1 minute.
You and allies in your Aura of Protection deal +1d4 on melee weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks.
Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, take a Reaction to give yourself or an ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you Advantage on a D20 Test; the use isn't spent if it still fails.

Once per Long Rest (or a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Aura of Fraternity becomes 1d8, you grant Heroic Inspiration to an ally in the aura each turn, and you and allies in it are immune to Blinded, Deafened, Exhaustion, and Poisoned.

As a Bonus Action produce webs lasting 1 minute: zip to a point within 30 feet without provoking (or as a Reaction while falling, 10 feet any direction); manipulate or snatch an unattended object under 10 pounds within 30 feet; make an anchored 60-foot rope; or, twice per Long Rest (one back on a Short Rest), cast Web in a 5-foot Cube for 1 minute with DC 8 + Dex mod + PB.
Your Sneak Attack can deal d8s of Poison instead of d6s of the weapon's type.
Climb Speed equal to your Speed, spider climb with free hands, and you can Hide on a ceiling while Lightly Obscured from enemies below.
When you take damage from a saving throw effect, use Uncanny Dodge as a Reaction to halve it.
New Cunning Strike option, Paralyze (4d6): when Venomous Strike deals Poison, the target makes a Con save or is Paralyzed until the end of your next turn.

Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Accelerate/Decelerate, Delay, Enhance Ability, Moment to Think, Recall; 5 Protection from Energy, Slow; 7 Death Ward, Dire Warning; 9 Legend Lore, Telepathic Bond. You also pick up a quirk from talking to yourself across time.

After each Short or Long Rest the GM secretly rolls a d20 and a d4, and tells you the d20 (lying if the d4 shows 4). Before any D20 Test by you or a creature you can see, you can replace it with the recorded d20.

name: I Could Do With Fewer Scars
spoken: i could do with fewer scars

display.description: Twice per Long Rest (one back on a Short Rest), when hit by an attack you can see, take a Reaction for +10 AC against it.
Advantage on Initiative and Resistance to all damage during the first round of combat.
Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action a creature within 60 feet makes an Int save: 10d6 Psychic and Stunned for 1 minute (repeat save each turn), or half damage only.

Own three masks (four at Bard 6, five at 14), swapping one per Long Rest; put on or switch one as a Bonus Action; remake a lost one in 8 hours. Angel: once per turn spend Bardic Inspiration to add a die of Radiant damage. Archmage: always prepared Fire Bolt, Scorching Ray, Thunderwave (3), Lightning Bolt (5), Ice Storm (7), Wall of Stone (9). Devil: Reaction when damaged by a creature within 30 feet, spend Inspiration for two dice of Fire damage to it and that much temp HP. Dragon: on donning and as a Bonus Action each turn, spend Inspiration for a 15-foot Cone, Dex save for two dice of Fire (half on success). Faceless: Disguise Self prepared, castable without a slot as a 1-minute, 8-hour casting. Gladiator: Martial weapons and Shields, and spend Inspiration for a Bonus Action attack. Hierophant: always prepared Aid, Cure Wounds, Spare the Dying (3), Revivify (5), Death Ward (7), Mass Cure Wounds (9). Jester: on donning and as a Bonus Action each turn move half your Speed without provoking, and spend Inspiration to cast Vicious Mockery with it. Noble: grant Bardic Inspiration as part of donning it, and creatures that fail a D20 Test with your die roll it twice and keep the higher.
Disguise Kit proficiency, and add your Bardic Inspiration die to Performance checks without spending it.
Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, once per turn make a D20 Test with Charisma instead of its usual ability.
Wear two masks at once and gain both.

On each Long Rest pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison; your Cleric spells and features can deal it instead of Necrotic or Radiant. Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, once per turn add damage of that type equal to your Cleric level.
Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Chromatic Orb, Command, Darkvision, Dragon's Breath; 5 Fly, Protection from Energy; 7 Banishment, Charm Monster; 9 Dominate Person, Summon Dragon.
Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: chosen creatures in a 30-foot Emanation make a Wisdom save or are Charmed or Frightened (your pick) for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn.
Spend a Channel Divinity to cast Dragon's Breath or Protection from Energy on yourself without a slot or Concentration.

Three times per Long Rest (or regain one with a level 2+ slot), take a Legendary Action right after another creature's turn, each option once per round. Rend: move your Speed and cast an action Cleric cantrip or make a melee attack using Wisdom. Tail Swipe: chosen Large or smaller creatures within 10 feet fall Prone. Wingbeat: move your Speed flying without provoking.
Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Grease, Jump, Shatter, Spider Climb; 5 Meld into Stone, Sending; 7 Fabricate, Stone Shape; 9 Animate Objects, Passwall.
Spend a Wild Shape use to cast Meld into Stone, Passwall, or Stone Shape without a slot.

Pick Acrobatics, History, Intimidation, Investigation, Persuasion, or Stealth each Long Rest and add Wis mod (min +1) to it. Your plant spells take urban forms, and plant-targeting spells like Speak with Plants and Tree Stride can use structures.
Your Wild Shape can become an Animate Objects object up to Large (Huge from Druid 10).

Once per Long Rest (or a level 3+ slot), when a creature within 60 feet takes damage from an attack, take a Reaction to raise a 10-by-10-foot stone panel (AC 15, 30 HP) between it and the attacker that takes the hit and vanishes at the end of your next turn.

As an animated object: AC 18; once per turn reduce damage under 10 to 0; Slam twice per Attack action; move through creatures, and those your size or smaller take 2d6 + Wis mod Bludgeoning and fall Prone (once per turn each).
Claws: Unarmed Strikes can use Dex and deal 1d6 + Str or Dex mod Slashing. Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Darkvision 60 feet (or +60).

After you damage an enemy, a Bonus Action raises your Bestial Aspect Level by 1 (resets after a minute without damaging an enemy). Benefits stack: 1 Carnage (+2 weapon and Unarmed Strike damage); 2 +10 feet Speed; 3 Advantage against creatures below full HP; 4 +2 AC without a Shield; 5 Reaction melee attack against an adjacent creature that damages you.
When you roll Initiative, roll a d4 and set your Bestial Aspect Level to the result.
You can cast Hunter's Mark as part of the Bonus Action that raises your Bestial Aspect, and Carnage becomes +3.
Once per turn reduce damage you take by Con mod + your Bestial Aspect Level.

Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Arc Blade, Burning Blade, Frigid Blade, Heroism, Magic Weapon, Mirror Image, Shield; 5 Haste, Phantom Steed; 7 Death Ward, Stoneskin; 9 Legend Lore, Hold Monster.

Martial weapons, Light and Medium armor, and Shields. While Innate Sorcery is active, attack with proficient weapons using Charisma. At the start of each turn you can spend 1 Sorcery Point for 1d6 + Sorcerer level temp HP.

On a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend 2 Sorcery Points as a Bonus Action to add 2d8 damage and one effect. Blinding Attack: Con save or Blinded 1 minute (repeat save). Ruinous Blow: -3 AC until the end of your next turn. Wounding Strike: a bleeding wound that blocks healing and deals 1d8 Necrotic per wound each turn, ignoring Resistance, until staunched with an action.
Haste on yourself can skip Concentration, and you suffer no lethargy when it ends.

Magic Missile is free in your spellbook. It fires one extra dart (two at Wizard 6, three at 10, four at 14), ignores effects that specifically block it such as Shield, and you can cast it without a slot Int mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, regaining one on a Short Rest.

Give up darts to add effects to a target the darts strike: Trip (1 dart, Str save or Prone), Blinding (3, Con save or Blinded until your next turn), Stunning (5, Con save or Stunned until your next turn).

Once per Long Rest (or a level 3+ slot), keep the darts orbiting you in a 10-foot Emanation for up to 1 minute: +1 AC per dart (max +5). A dart strikes anyone within 120 feet who misses you, and you can fire darts at creatures the Emanation touches (once per creature per turn).
Once per Long Rest (or a level 6+ slot), each dart deals extra Force equal to your Int mod (min 1).
+1 AC while unarmored, Resistance to Cold damage, and Con mod times (min 1) per Long Rest you can extend a Rage that would end (no action) unless you are Unconscious.
Once per turn while Raging, a Strength-based hit adds 1d6 Cold (2d6 at Barbarian 9, 3d6 at 16) and cuts the target's Speed by 10 feet until your next turn.
Entering Rage while unarmored grants 1d12 + Con mod temp HP; on later turns of the Rage, a Bonus Action and a Hit Die grants them again.

You can hibernate through a Long Rest, appearing dead to all inspection and magic and ignoring noise. Six unbroken hours give a Long Rest plus a bonus pool of Con mod (min 1) Barbarian Hit Dice until your next Long Rest; damage or a slap wakes you.
As a Magic action, chosen creatures in a 15-foot Emanation make a Dex save (DC 8 + Str mod + PB) or take 3d6 + Str mod Bludgeoning and fall Prone.
As a Bonus Action spend a Bardic Inspiration: a creature that can see you gains temp HP equal to the die + Cha mod (min 2) and can use its Reaction to move its Speed without provoking or Dodge.

A creature that hits you with an Opportunity Attack or while you're Dodging takes Psychic damage equal to Cha mod + half your Bard level. Charm Person is always prepared, castable without Verbal components, and once per Long Rest without a slot as a level 3 spell whose targets get no Advantage from fighting you.
A creature receiving Inspirational Dance can instead use its Reaction to attack once. You can Dodge as a Bonus Action, including as part of any Bonus Action that spends Bardic Inspiration.
Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Blur, Guiding Bolt, Invisibility, Longstrider, Starry Wisp; 5 Blink, Slow; 7 Banishment, Dimension Door; 9 Teleportation Circle, Wall of Force.
Spend a Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to open a 15-foot-radius vacuum within 60 feet: Dex save or 1d8 + Cleric level Force and pulled 15 feet toward the center, or half damage only.
Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, a Touch spell you cast has a 30-foot range instead.
Misty Step always prepared; cast it with a Channel Divinity instead of a slot, and then you can swap places with a willing creature within 30 feet.

Any Misty Step can swap you with a willing creature. With Channel Divinity you can target an unwilling one (Charisma save negates and wastes the use), and on a successful swap you can cast a level 0-5 Touch spell with an action or Bonus Action casting time on that creature as part of the same Bonus Action.
Shillelagh works on any melee weapon you hold, which can keep its own damage die, and any proficient weapon can be your Druid Spellcasting Focus.
Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Ensnaring Strike, Shillelagh, Shining Smite, True Strike; 5 Haste; 7 Fire Shield; 9 Flame Strike.
As a Bonus Action spend a Wild Shape use to heal 2d6 + Druid level (3d6 at Druid 10, 4d6 at 14).
With a Shillelagh weapon you attack twice per Attack action and get +1 to attack and damage (+2 at Druid 10, +3 at 14; doesn't stack with the weapon's own bonus).
Replace one Attack action attack with an action Druid cantrip.
You are always under Barkskin. At the start of each turn gain temp HP equal to half your Druid level, and on assuming Wild Shape gain temp HP equal to 1.5 times your Druid level.

Mercy Dice: three d6 (four at Fighter 7, d8s at 10, five at 15, d10s at 18), regained on a Short or Long Rest. Benevolent Presence: add any number to Insight, Performance, or Persuasion checks. Merciless Strike: once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, add one as Radiant damage. Peaceful Ward: as a Bonus Action, gain temp HP equal to one + Cha mod (min 1).
Proficiency in Insight and Persuasion. You can knock out instead of kill with any attack, leaving the target at 1 HP, Unconscious, and resting until healed or given first aid (DC 10 Medicine).
Your weapon and Unarmed Strike damage can be Radiant. Calm Emotions and Sanctuary are always prepared (Charisma, no Somatic or Material components), each once per Short or Long Rest without a slot.
Regain a Mercy Die for each creature you persuade to stand down. Immune to Charmed and Frightened.

As a Bonus Action spend a Mercy Die on a creature within 30 feet that can hear you: temp HP equal to the roll + Cha mod, and it can use its Reaction to move half its Speed without provoking and attack once; that attack only knocks out.

Once per turn, Merciless Strike costs no Mercy Die (and you can use it again that turn by paying one). Creatures you knock out stay Unconscious for 8 hours or until you or an ally shakes them awake, even if healed.
Telepathy with any creature within 30 feet that knows a language (one-way).

When you touch or hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, spend 1 Focus Point (free on Flurry of Blows hits) to read its emotions and most obvious desire until the end of your next turn (1 minute out of combat), perhaps its HP or a piece of history, and gain Advantage on your next attack against it this turn and on Insight checks with it.

As a Magic action touch a Bloodied creature and spend Focus Points to heal 5 HP each, up to half its HP maximum. Spend 2 Focus Points to cast Enhance Ability, Lesser Restoration, or Protection from Evil and Good without a slot or Material components (Wisdom).

Dream and Scrying always prepared, each once per Long Rest without a slot or Material components (you must be the Dream messenger). Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, a hit made with Advantage adds a Martial Arts die of Radiant damage.
Stabilizing Focus works as a Bonus Action and at 30 feet. You fly at your Speed but fall if you end your turn airborne. Unarmed Strikes deal +1d4 Radiant.
Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Burning Hands, Find Familiar; 5 Aid, Continual Flame; 9 Beacon of Hope, Daylight; 13 Fire Shield, Guardian of Faith; 17 Flame Strike, Rary's Telepathic Bond.

When you take the Attack action, spend a Channel Divinity to ignite a held melee weapon for 10 minutes: hits deal +Cha mod (min 1) Fire and can deal Fire instead of their type, and it sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim 20 more.
You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Resistance to Cold and Fire damage.
Whenever you cast a level 1+ Paladin spell with a slot (or a level 1+ spell through a Paladin feature), you and allies in your aura gain temp HP equal to the spell's level + Cha mod (min 2).

Once per Long Rest (or a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: your aura fills with Bright Light (Dim 30 feet beyond); +10 feet Speed and you can move through and end in others' spaces without anyone falling Prone; and at the end of each of your turns chosen creatures in a 10-foot Emanation take Fire equal to twice your Cha mod (min 2).

Once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, add 1d6 of the attack's type and cut the target's Speed by 10 feet until your next turn. At Ranger 11 it becomes 1d8 and the target also can't make Opportunity Attacks until your next turn.
Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Ice Knife; 5 Mirror Image; 9 Sleet Storm; 13 Hallucinatory Terrain; 17 Hold Monster.

No Disadvantage on attacks against Prone targets more than 5 feet away. Icy or snowy Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement and gives Advantage on Stealth. You can't be Prone unless you are also Incapacitated.

Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action set an invisible trap in your space for 1 minute: the first Large or smaller creature to enter (other than you or chosen creatures) makes a Dex save, taking 2d8 Piercing and Speed 0 until the end of your next turn, or half damage only.
When a creature within 5 feet misses you, take a Reaction to knock it Prone (or halve a larger creature's Speed this turn), then attack it once or move half your Speed without provoking it.

Expertise with Calligrapher's and Painter's Supplies; conjure either kit plus ink or paint as a Magic action (they vanish if they leave you). Any mark you paint can hold a Message that glows faintly until someone touches it and hears it.

4 Rune Points, regained on a Short or Long Rest. When you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend 1 to mark the creature for up to 1 minute (it can wipe the mark off with an action). Cryos: no Reactions until your next turn. Hexxus: when it succeeds on a check or attack within 60 feet, a Reaction subtracts 1d6. Locus: the next attack against it has Advantage and deals +1d6 Acid on a hit.

Advantage on checks and saves to avoid or escape Grappled and Restrained, and escaping takes only a Bonus Action. Next to a solid surface, a Bonus Action and 1 Rune Point make you Invisible for 10 minutes until you attack, deal damage, cast a spell, or leave that space.
On rolling Initiative, refill to 2 Rune Points if lower. Spend Rune Points to forgo one fewer Sneak Attack die per point for Cunning Strike effects.
Against a creature bearing (or receiving) your rune you can Sneak Attack without Advantage or an adjacent ally (unless you have Disadvantage), and that Sneak Attack deals +2d6.
Touching a surface, as a Bonus Action ice over five contiguous 5-foot squares as Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn, plus five more per Sorcery Point.
Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Blindness/Deafness, Ice Knife, Misty Step, Sleep; 5 Sleet Storm, Slow; 7 Fire Shield, Ice Storm; 9 Cone of Cold, Conjure Elemental (Cold only).
+3 HP maximum and +1 per later Sorcerer level. Icy or snowy Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement, and on ice each foot of movement carries you 2 feet.

Resistance to Cold damage. When your spell deals Cold damage to a Large or smaller creature, spend Sorcery Points to cut its Speed by 15 feet each until the end of its next turn; reaching 0 also deals 2d6 Cold. Create Ice can freeze water 5 feet deep, holding up to Large creatures.
Moving on ice doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. When a creature within 5 feet hits you, take a Reaction to deal Cold equal to Cha mod + half your Sorcerer level and use Create Ice.
Immunity to Cold and Resistance to Fire. Wall of Ice is always prepared without its Material component, and once per Long Rest castable without a slot with non-contiguous panels if flat.
Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Identify, Locate Object, Magic Missile, Rope Trick; 5 Blink, Clairvoyance; 7 Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum, Leomund's Secret Chest; 9 Legend Lore, Passwall.
Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest cast Magic Missile without a slot; its darts can target creatures you can't see.

A personal pocket dimension holding 50 pounds in 1 cubic foot, reached by hand. Putting another extradimensional container inside destroys both and locks you out for 7 days. You sense other extradimensional spaces within 60 feet.

Once per Short or Long Rest, when you take damage, take a Reaction to halve it and slip into an overlapping demiplane, unseen by the plane you left, until the end of your next turn or until you return.

Resistance to Force damage. Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, a Magic action grants Truesight 30 feet and Advantage on sight-based Perception for 10 minutes. You sense the contents of extradimensional magic items within 10 feet.

Your pocket holds 250 pounds in 10 cubic feet. As a Magic action pull an unworn object within 30 feet into it (a carrier makes a Wis save, and that version is once per Short or Long Rest); unretrieved by the end of your next turn, it pops out within 5 feet or into your hand.

Learn Mending (or another Wizard cantrip) for free. Proficiency with three Artisan's Tools, swapping one each Long Rest. Crafting with proficient tools, cut each day's required hours by your Int mod (min 1; at least 2 hours).

When you cast a level 1+ spell, create a 5-foot cube of any inanimate material within 30 feet (60 at Wizard 10) or attached to another of your cubes. Each weighs 25 pounds, holds ten times that, gives cover, has AC 10 + Int mod and 1 HP, and lasts an hour; you can have as many as your Wizard level and dismiss them as a Bonus Action. Int mod times (min 1) per Long Rest (or regain uses with slots) you can detonate dismissed cubes instead: creatures within 10 feet make a Dex save for 1d6 + half your Wizard level Force, half on success.

Twice per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action give an object one benefit per use until your next rest: weapon +1 (+2 at Wizard 10, +3 at 14); armor +1 AC (same scaling); no Stealth Disadvantage; light 20/20 feet; half weight and no Strength requirement or Heavy penalty; returns when thrown; or cosmetic changes. Each benefit only once per recharge.
Your spells deal double damage to objects and structures, and your damage to Constructs adds 1d8 Force.

Once per Long Rest, when a Large or smaller nonmagical object or structure is destroyed within 60 feet, a Reaction stores its debris; within 8 hours a Magic action rebuilds it intact within 60 feet. Dropped from the air, it deals 1d6/2d6/3d6 Bludgeoning per 10 feet fallen (by size) to those beneath on a failed Dex save, half on success.
Alchemist's Supplies with proficiency; craft Potions of Healing with them instead of an Herbalism Kit.

When you Rage, inject one serum for the Rage (swap as a Bonus Action). Ferocity: ignore Difficult Terrain and trigger Cleave alongside another mastery on melee hits. Monstrosity: grow to Large (space permitting), +5 feet reach, and once per turn add your Rage Damage bonus to a missed Strength attack roll. Reconstruction: on injecting and at the start of each turn, spend and roll a Hit Die to heal it + Con mod, excess as temp HP (not the turn after Acid or Fire damage).

Also activate a compound with your serum. Stimulated Senses: Blindsight 30 feet (or +30). Maddening Fumes: a 30-foot Emanation halves enemies' Speed, and those starting a turn there make a Wis save (DC 8 + Con mod + PB) or have Disadvantage attacking others until their next turn. Corrosive Expulsion: replace an attack with a 15-foot Cone or 30-foot Line of acid; Dex save for d8s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, half on success.
When you take damage or become Blinded, Deafened, Poisoned, or Stunned, take a Reaction to Rage first, ending those conditions. Advantage on Con saves while Raging.
Activate two serums at once. While Raging, a creature within 5 feet that damages you with a melee attack takes 1d12 Acid (once per turn).

When you give Bardic Inspiration, summon a haint around the target for 1 minute with a 15-foot aura (it ends when you use its Reaction). Grump: Advantage on Intimidation and Str saves in the aura, and a Reaction adds an Inspiration die + Cha mod to one creature's damage. Sad Sack: Half Cover against ranged attacks in the aura, and a Reaction reduces damage to a creature by an Inspiration die + Cha mod. Scamp: +10 feet Speed for those starting a turn in it, and a Reaction lets a creature reroll a failed save.

On a Long Rest turn a bag into a bindle that works as a Handy Haversack (one at a time; it fails beyond 1 mile). You can whistle Verbal components; observers need DC 15 Arcana to recognize the casting.

On each Long Rest mark the spot (up to Cha mod marks). Once per Long Rest cast Teleportation Circle to a mark as a phantom train. From Bard 9, Teleportation Circle is always prepared and can target your marks.

Once per Long Rest (or a level 3+ slot), as a Magic action a ghost train runs a 120-foot by 10-foot Line: you and up to six willing creatures within 30 feet teleport to a space along it, and others in the Line make a Wis save or are Deafened, pushed 10 feet, and take three Inspiration dice of Psychic.

Once per Long Rest (or a level 7+ slot), as a Magic action up to six creatures within 300 feet make a Cha save or are cursed for up to 1 minute (repeat save each turn): Psychic damage Frightens them of its source, and the first Psychic hit gives them Vulnerability to Psychic.
Herbalism Kit with proficiency, plus Nature or Survival.

After each rest pick Sowing, Growing, or Reaping and have that column prepared up to your level. Sowing: 3 Druidcraft, Goodberry, Lesser Restoration; 5 Harvest Moonglow; 7 Death Ward; 9 Awaken. Growing: 3 Guidance, Entangle, Summer Winds; 5 Plant Growth; 7 Sanctum of the Shepherd; 9 Mass Cure Wounds. Reaping: 3 Chill Touch, Inflict Wounds, Hold Person; 5 Culling Sickle; 7 Consuming Pyre; 9 Field of Reaping.
Once per Long Rest, start a Short Rest by conjuring food for twice your PB creatures; at the rest's end divide Cleric-level d4s of healing among those who ate.

Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: up to six creatures within 60 feet gain Heroic Inspiration (once per Long Rest each) plus one aspect's boon, which becomes your aspect. Sowing: temp HP equal to PB + Wis mod. Growing: +1d4 to attacks and checks until the end of your next turn. Reaping: +PB Necrotic on their first damage before the end of your next turn.

Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, when a creature within 30 feet fails a save of your aspect's types (Sowing Dex/Cha, Growing Con/Int, Reaping Wis/Str), take a Reaction to let it reroll; afterward it heals PB d4s.

Once per Long Rest (or a level 7+ slot), Bountiful Harvest adds: Sowing, Regenerate for 1 minute; Growing, Advantage on saves and checks for up to 1 hour (Concentration); Reaping, Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Poison for 1 hour.

name: Circle of the Old Ways Spells
spoken: circle of the old ways spells

display.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Ancestral Communion, Barkskin, Shield of Faith, Shillelagh, Spike Growth; 5 Magic Circle, Plant Growth; 7 Freedom of Movement, Private Sanctum; 9 Awaken, Tree Stride.

Casting Shillelagh can grow a wooden Shield in your free hand for its duration; you can't be disarmed of either unless Incapacitated, you ignore Somatic components of Druid spells, and the weapon is your Druidic Focus.

As a Bonus Action or while casting Shillelagh, spend a Wild Shape use for 10 minutes: unarmored AC 10 + Dex + Wis; Shillelagh hits coat the target in sap so it has Disadvantage attacking anyone but you until your next turn; Advantage on Str and Con saves.
During Wood Wose: two attacks per Attack action, and once per turn a melee weapon hit adds 1d6 Piercing.
During Wood Wose: once per turn a melee hit forces a Str save or Prone; melee attackers within 5 feet take 1d8 Piercing (once per turn); and you gain Wis mod + PB temp HP on activation and each turn.
During Wood Wose: grow to Large with +5 feet reach, Resistance to Bludgeoning and Piercing, and a Reaction melee attack when a sap-coated creature in reach makes an attack roll.

As a Bonus Action spend a Wild Shape use to set a Small wicker effigy within 30 feet for 1 minute (AC 15, HP 5 x Druid level, Vulnerable to Fire) with a 30-foot dimly lit aura. Sacrifice: Reaction to deal 1d8 + Wis mod Fire to a creature in it that takes damage. Soothe: on creation and as a Bonus Action later, heal a creature in it 1d6 (twice your spellcasting modifier times). Ward: +1 AC to you and allies in it.
Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Bane, Bless, Summer Winds, Zone of Truth; 5 Bestow Curse, Tiny Hut; 7 Death Ward, Sanctum of the Shepherd; 9 Hold Monster, Lucky Charm.
On each Long Rest make PB tokens; you can cast Touch spells on anyone carrying one on your plane.

Sacrifice becomes 2d8 + Wis mod. Soothe heals 1d8 and can spend 5 of the effigy's HP to end Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned. Ward also grants Resistance to one non-Force damage type.

As a Magic action spend a Wild Shape use to make a doll of a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute (AC 10, 10 HP): it has Disadvantage attacking whoever carries the doll, and that carrier's first damage to it each turn adds 2d10 Necrotic.

Switch the effigy's aura at the start of your turn. Sacrifice becomes 3d8 + Wis mod; Soothe ends Charmed or Frightened on those starting a turn there; Ward also grants Advantage on saves of one chosen ability.

Draugr Dice: four d6 (six d8 at Fighter 5, eight at 9, eight d10 at 11, ten at 13, twelve d12 at 17); regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest; save DC 8 + Con mod + PB. Dark Rider: once per Short or Long Rest (or spend a die), as a Bonus Action summon a ghostly Undead Warhorse for 1 hour with B/P/S Resistance that can only Dash, Disengage, or Dodge; spend a die on its Dash to add 5 feet per point rolled. Grave Guard: Reaction to reduce damage by a die + Con mod. Soul Reaper: give up an attack to grip a creature within 60 feet with ghostly hands: Str save or a die + Con mod Necrotic and Grappled for 1 minute, half damage only on success.
When a non-Construct, non-Undead enemy within 30 feet dies, a Reaction regains a Draugr Die. Spend a die to add it to an ability check.

Your steed ignores Difficult Terrain, and when it Dashes, Disengages, or Dodges you can spend a die to teleport it 60 feet; chosen creatures within 10 feet of where it appears make a Con save for a die + Con mod Necrotic, half on success. Grave Guard returns half the prevented damage as Psychic to the attacker. Creatures held by Soul Reaper take PB Psychic at the start of their turns, plus a die with your Reaction.

Dark Rider can carry a passenger, and spending a die on its Dash lets it pass through objects and creatures. Grave Guard also grants Resistance to one triggering damage type until your next turn. Soul Reaper's grapple also Restrains.
You don't age or need air, food, drink, or sleep. When you roll Initiative with fewer than 3 Draugr Dice, refill to 3.

Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Slashing, and Flurry of Blows hits add a Martial Arts die of Necrotic. Miasmic Plague: on an Unarmed Strike hit, spend 1 Focus Point (or forgo the Flurry bonus) for a Con save or 1 minute cursed: Poisoned and once per turn taking a Martial Arts die of extra Necrotic from your Unarmed Strikes, repeating the save each turn.

Advantage on saves against Poisoned and magical contagions and Resistance to Poison and Necrotic. Talk simply with vermin, and once per Long Rest cast Animal Messenger on a plague-bearing Tiny Beast (Wisdom).
Your Necrotic and Poison damage ignores Resistance to those types.
As a Magic action spend 2 Focus Points: chosen creatures in a 20-foot Emanation make a Con save for two Martial Arts dice Necrotic and Miasmic Plague, half damage only on success.
Saves against Miasmic Plague have Disadvantage. Spending a Focus Point on Step of the Wind lets you plague chosen creatures you pass within 5 feet of (Con save, once per turn each).
Miasmic Plague ignores immunity to Poisoned, and your Necrotic damage to a plagued creature adds a Martial Arts die.

Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: up to Cha mod creatures within 30 feet make a Str save or are shackled in fire with Speed 0 for up to 1 minute (repeat save each turn); a Bonus Action flares the shackles for 2d6 Fire each.
